    function()
local knifeAssetTemplate = nil
local skinSoundConnections = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local function createKnifeFallback(handle, model)
        -- Fallback silhouette if this executor cannot load the Creator Store model.
        local faceRotation = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
        local baseOffset = CFrame.new(0, -0.34, 0)
        local steel = Color3.fromRGB(196, 201, 208)
        local black = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 22)

        local function attach(name, size, color, material, offset, rotation)
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Name = name
            p.Size = size
            p.Color = color
            p.Material = material
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.CanTouch = false
            p.CanQuery = false
            p.Massless = true
            p.CastShadow = false
            p.Parent = model
            local weld = Instance.new("Motor6D")
            weld.Part0 = handle
            weld.Part1 = p
            weld.C0 = baseOffset * faceRotation * offset * (rotation or CFrame.new())
            weld.Parent = p
            return p
        end

        -- Grip length increased slightly; no loose decorative block above it.
        attach("KnifeHandle", Vector3.new(0.17, 1.16, 0.14), black,
            Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, CFrame.new(0, -1.31, 0))
        attach("KnifePommel", Vector3.new(0.18, 0.09, 0.15), Color3.fromRGB(55,55,58),
            Enum.Material.Metal, CFrame.new(0, -1.92, 0))

        -- Main blade moved forward and kept as one simple rectangular piece.
        attach("KnifeBlade", Vector3.new(0.19, 0.92, 0.032), steel,
            Enum.Material.Metal, CFrame.new(0, -0.12, 0))

        -- The point is centered on the blade's axis and slightly overlaps its end.
        local tip = Instance.new("WedgePart")
        tip.Name = "KnifeBladePoint"
        tip.Size = Vector3.new(0.19, 0.34, 0.032)
        tip.Color = steel
        tip.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        tip.CanCollide = false
        tip.CanTouch = false
        tip.CanQuery = false
        tip.Massless = true
        tip.CastShadow = false
        tip.Parent = model
        local tipWeld = Instance.new("Motor6D")
        tipWeld.Part0 = handle
        tipWeld.Part1 = tip
        tipWeld.C0 = baseOffset * faceRotation * CFrame.new(0, 0.49, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
        tipWeld.Parent = tip
    end
    local function createKnife(handle, model, assetId)
        -- Draw the built-in knife immediately; the public asset replaces it once loaded.
        createKnifeFallback(handle, model)
        -- Clone the public model. The positive end of this asset is the grip;
        -- aim its blade end forward and seat the grip at the equipped hand.
        local source
        if knifeAssetTemplate then
            local cloneOk, clone = pcall(function() return knifeAssetTemplate:Clone() end)
            if cloneOk then source = clone end
        end
        if not source then
            local loadedOk, loaded = pcall(function()
                return game:GetObjects(assetId or "rbxassetid://470580344")
            end)
            source = loadedOk and type(loaded) == "table" and loaded[1] or nil
            if source then pcall(function() knifeAssetTemplate = source:Clone() end) end
        end
        local sourceParts = {}
        if source then
            if source:IsA("BasePart") then
                sourceParts[#sourceParts + 1] = source
            end
            for _, d in ipairs(source:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                    sourceParts[#sourceParts + 1] = d
                end
            end
        end
        if #sourceParts > 0 then
            local boundsCFrame, boundsSize
            pcall(function()
                if source:IsA("Model") then
                    boundsCFrame, boundsSize = source:GetBoundingBox()
                elseif source:IsA("BasePart") then
                    boundsCFrame, boundsSize = source.CFrame, source.Size
                end
            end)
            if boundsCFrame and boundsSize then
                local longest = math.max(boundsSize.X, boundsSize.Y, boundsSize.Z)
                if longest > 0 then
                    local sizes = {boundsSize.X, boundsSize.Y, boundsSize.Z}
                    local axes = {Vector3.new(1,0,0), Vector3.new(0,1,0), Vector3.new(0,0,1)}
                    local majorIndex, thinIndex = 1, 1
                    for i = 2, 3 do
                        if sizes[i] > sizes[majorIndex] then majorIndex = i end
                        if sizes[i] < sizes[thinIndex] then thinIndex = i end
                    end
                    if thinIndex == majorIndex then thinIndex = (majorIndex % 3) + 1 end
                    local sourceMajor = axes[majorIndex]
                    local sourceThin = axes[thinIndex]
                    local sourceMiddle = sourceMajor:Cross(sourceThin).Unit
                    -- Blade tip forward; flat faces oriented toward avatar left/right.
                    local targetMajor = Vector3.new(0,0,1)
                    local targetThin = Vector3.new(1,0,0)
                    local targetMiddle = targetMajor:Cross(targetThin)
                    local function mapAxis(axis)
                        return targetMajor * axis:Dot(sourceMajor)
                            + targetThin * axis:Dot(sourceThin)
                            + targetMiddle * axis:Dot(sourceMiddle)
                    end
                    local axisRotation = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.new(0,0,0),
                        mapAxis(axes[1]), mapAxis(axes[2]), mapAxis(axes[3]))
                    local scale = 2.15 / longest
                    -- Keep the knife in one fixed pose relative to the equipped Handle.
                    -- Do not read HumanoidRootPart/LookVector: those can change abruptly
                    -- during ragdoll and character state transitions.
                    local handleFrame = handle.CFrame
                    local fixedGripC0 = CFrame.new(0, -1.42, 0)
                    local gripPosition = (handleFrame * fixedGripC0).Position
                        - handleFrame.LookVector * 0.50
                    local totalLength = longest * scale
                    local gripInset = math.min(0.34, totalLength * 0.18)
                    local centerForward = math.max(totalLength * 0.5 - gripInset, 0)
                    -- The same upright angle and hand-relative offset are used every time.
                    local fixedKnifeRotation = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(40), 0, 0)
                    local targetFrame = CFrame.new(gripPosition)
                        * (handleFrame - handleFrame.Position)
                        * fixedKnifeRotation * CFrame.new(0, 0, -centerForward)
                    local clones = {}
                    for _, sourcePart in ipairs(sourceParts) do
                        local cloneOk, p = pcall(function() return sourcePart:Clone() end)
                        if cloneOk and p then
                            for _, child in ipairs(p:GetDescendants()) do
                                if child:IsA("Script") or child:IsA("LocalScript") or child:IsA("ModuleScript") then
                                    pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
                                end
                            end
                            local localFrame = boundsCFrame:ToObjectSpace(sourcePart.CFrame)
                            local worldFrame = targetFrame * axisRotation
                                * CFrame.new(localFrame.Position * scale) * localFrame.Rotation
                            local relative = handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(worldFrame)
                            p.Name = "KitchenKnifeMeshPart"
                            p.Size = sourcePart.Size * scale
                            p.Anchored = false
                            p.CanCollide = false
                            p.CanTouch = false
                            p.CanQuery = false
                            p.Massless = true
                            p.CastShadow = false
                            p.CFrame = worldFrame
                            p.Parent = model
                            local weld = Instance.new("Motor6D")
                            weld.Name = "KitchenKnifeAssetJoint"
                            weld.Part0 = handle
                            weld.Part1 = p
                            weld.C0 = relative
                            weld.C1 = CFrame.new()
                            weld.Parent = p
                            clones[#clones + 1] = p
                        end
                    end
                    if #clones == #sourceParts and #clones > 0 then
                        for _, fallbackPart in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
                            if fallbackPart.Name == "KnifeHandle"
                                or fallbackPart.Name == "KnifePommel"
                                or fallbackPart.Name == "KnifeBlade"
                                or fallbackPart.Name == "KnifeBladePoint" then
                                pcall(function() fallbackPart:Destroy() end)
                            end
                        end
                        pcall(function() source:Destroy() end)
                        return
                    end
                    for _, p in ipairs(clones) do
                        pcall(function() p:Destroy() end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if source then pcall(function() source:Destroy() end) end
        if not _G._MonsterKnifeAssetWarned then
            _G._MonsterKnifeAssetWarned = true
            warn("[Monster] Kitchen Knife asset could not be loaded; using the built-in knife fallback.")
        end
    end
    local function createPocketKnife(handle, model)
        local grip=Instance.new("Part")
        grip.Name="KnifeHandle"
        grip.Size=Vector3.new(0.15,1.18,0.14)
        grip.Color=Color3.fromRGB(20,20,20)
        grip.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        grip.CanCollide=false; grip.CanTouch=false; grip.CanQuery=false; grip.Massless=true
        grip.Parent=model
        local gripMotor=Instance.new("Motor6D")
        gripMotor.Part0=handle; gripMotor.Part1=grip
        gripMotor.C0=CFrame.new(0,-1.42,0); gripMotor.Parent=grip

        local blade=Instance.new("Part")
        blade.Name="KnifeBlade"
        blade.Size=Vector3.new(0.15,1.25,0.03)
        blade.Color=Color3.fromRGB(190,193,198)
        blade.Material=Enum.Material.Metal
        blade.CanCollide=false; blade.CanTouch=false; blade.CanQuery=false; blade.Massless=true
        blade.Parent=model
        local bladeMotor=Instance.new("Motor6D")
        bladeMotor.Part0=handle; bladeMotor.Part1=blade
        bladeMotor.C0=CFrame.new(0,-0.40,0); bladeMotor.Parent=blade
        local tip=Instance.new("WedgePart")
        tip.Name="KnifeTip"
        tip.Size=Vector3.new(0.15,0.42,0.03)
        tip.Color=blade.Color; tip.Material=Enum.Material.Metal
        tip.CanCollide=false; tip.CanTouch=false; tip.CanQuery=false; tip.Massless=true
        tip.Parent=model
        local tipMotor=Instance.new("Motor6D")
        tipMotor.Part0=handle; tipMotor.Part1=tip
        tipMotor.C0=CFrame.new(0,0.36,0)
        tipMotor.Parent=tip
    end
local function attachSound(tool, handle, data, isActive)
if not data.soundId then return end
local customSound = handle:FindFirstChild("M4KnifeSkinSound")
if not customSound then
customSound = Instance.new("Sound")
customSound.Name = "M4KnifeSkinSound"
customSound.Parent = handle
end
customSound.SoundId = data.soundId
customSound.Volume = data.soundVolume or 2
if customSound:GetAttribute("PreloadedSoundId") ~= data.soundId then
customSound:SetAttribute("PreloadedSoundId", data.soundId)
task.spawn(function()
pcall(function() game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync({customSound}) end)
end)
end
for _, sourceSound in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
if sourceSound:IsA("Sound") and sourceSound ~= customSound and sourceSound.Name:sub(1, 2) ~= "M4" and not skinSoundConnections[sourceSound] then
skinSoundConnections[sourceSound] = sourceSound.Played:Connect(function()
if not isActive() or not customSound.Parent then return end
pcall(function()
sourceSound:Stop()
customSound:Stop()
customSound.TimePosition = 0
customSound:Play()
end)
end)
end
end
end
return {createKnife = createKnife, createPocketKnife = createPocketKnife, attachSound = attachSound}
end)()
local ExtraSkins=(function()
local cache={}
local RED=Color3.fromRGB(200,0,0)
local REDL=Color3.fromRGB(255,100,100)
local REDD=Color3.fromRGB(140,0,0)
local function loadAsset(id)
local key=tostring(id)
if cache[key]then return cache[key]end
local src
local ok,objs=pcall(function()return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..key)end)
if ok and type(objs)=="table"and objs[1]then src=objs[1]else pcall(function()src=game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(tonumber(key))end)end
if src then cache[key]=src end
return src
end
local function sanitize(model,red)
for _,obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("Script")or obj:IsA("LocalScript")or obj:IsA("ModuleScript")or obj:IsA("ScreenGui")or obj:IsA("BillboardGui")or obj:IsA("SurfaceGui")or obj:IsA("Weld")or obj:IsA("WeldConstraint")or obj:IsA("Motor6D")or obj:IsA("Sound")or obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt")or obj:IsA("ClickDetector")then
pcall(function()obj:Destroy()end)
elseif obj:IsA("BasePart")then
pcall(function()
obj.Anchored=false obj.CanCollide=false obj.CanTouch=false obj.CanQuery=false obj.Massless=true obj.CastShadow=false
if red then
local c=obj.Color
if obj.Material==Enum.Material.Neon or(c.R>0.38 and c.R>c.B*1.05 and c.G<0.45)or(c.R>0.5 and c.G>0.2 and c.B<0.25)then obj.Color=RED end
end
end)
elseif red then
pcall(function()
if obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter")then obj.Enabled=true obj.Color=ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,REDL),ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5,RED),ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,REDD)})
elseif obj:IsA("Trail")or obj:IsA("Beam")then obj.Enabled=true obj.Color=ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,REDL),ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,REDD)})
elseif obj:IsA("PointLight")or obj:IsA("SpotLight")or obj:IsA("SurfaceLight")then obj.Color=RED
elseif obj:IsA("Fire")then obj.Color=RED obj.SecondaryColor=REDL
elseif obj:IsA("Sparkles")or obj:IsA("Smoke")then obj.Color=RED
elseif obj:IsA("SpecialMesh")then obj.VertexColor=Vector3.new(0.85,0.1,0.1)end
end)
end
end
end
local function weldAll(model,handle,name)
for _,p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
if p:IsA("BasePart")then
p.Anchored=false
local w=Instance.new("WeldConstraint")w.Name=name w.Part0=handle w.Part1=p w.Parent=p
end
end
end
-- Cursed Hub style bat skins (asset scaled to fit, oriented by axis + adjust)
local function createCursed(handle,model,data)
local src=loadAsset(data.assetId)
if not src then return false end
local clone=src:Clone()
if clone:IsA("Script")or clone:IsA("LocalScript")or clone:IsA("ModuleScript")then clone:Destroy()return false end
for _,obj in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants())do
local n=string.lower(obj.Name or"")
if n:find("sheath")or n:find("scabbard")or n:find("saya")or n:find("case")or n:find("cover")then pcall(function()obj:Destroy()end)end
if obj:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")or obj:IsA("MaterialVariant")then pcall(function()obj:Destroy()end)end
end
local holder
if clone:IsA("Model")then holder=clone holder.Parent=model
else
if not clone:IsA("BasePart")and not clone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)then clone:Destroy()return false end
holder=Instance.new("Model")holder.Parent=model clone.Parent=holder
end
sanitize(holder,data.redVFX~=false)
local anyPart=holder:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
if not anyPart then return false end
local adjust=data.adjust or{}
local _,size=holder:GetBoundingBox()
local longest=math.max(size.X,size.Y,size.Z)
if longest>0 then pcall(function()holder:ScaleTo(math.clamp((adjust.scale or 5)/longest,0.15,8))end)end
local _,s2=holder:GetBoundingBox()
local rot=CFrame.new()
if s2.X>s2.Y and s2.X>s2.Z then rot=CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(90))elseif s2.Z>s2.Y and s2.Z>s2.X then rot=CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90),0,0)end
pcall(function()holder:PivotTo(handle.CFrame*CFrame.new(adjust.x or 0,adjust.y or 0,adjust.z or 0)*rot*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(adjust.rx or 0),math.rad(adjust.ry or 0),math.rad(adjust.rz or 0)))end)
weldAll(holder,handle,"M4CursedWeld")
return true
end
-- Medusa asset overlays (grip offset only)
local function createMedAsset(handle,model,data)
local src=loadAsset(data.assetId)
if not src then return false end
local holder=Instance.new("Model")holder.Parent=model
local clone=src:Clone()clone.Parent=holder
sanitize(holder,false)
if not holder:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)then return false end
local ok=pcall(function()
if not holder.PrimaryPart then holder.PrimaryPart=holder:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)end
holder:PivotTo(handle.CFrame*(data.grip or CFrame.new()))
end)
if not ok then return false end
weldAll(holder,handle,"M4MedAssetWeld")
return true
end
return{createCursed=createCursed,createMedAsset=createMedAsset}
end)()

local out={}

if size.X>=size.Y and size.X>=size.Z then return 1,size.X elseif size.Y>=size.X and size.Y>=size.Z then return 2,size.Y else return 3,size.Z end end local function smallestOtherAxis(size,longAxis)
local vals={size.X,size.Y,size.Z}
local best,bestVal=nil,math.huge for i=1,3 do if i~=longAxis and vals[i]<bestVal then best=i bestVal=vals[i]
end end return best end local function axisVector(cf,axis)
if axis==1 then return cf.RightVector end if axis==2 then return cf.UpVector end return-cf.LookVector end local dirs={Vector3.new(1,0,0),Vector3.new(-1,0,0),Vector3.new(0,1,0),Vector3.new(0,-1,0),Vector3.new(0,0,1),Vector3.new(0,0,-1)}
local rotations={}
for _,x in ipairs(dirs)do for _,y in ipairs(dirs)do if math.abs(x:Dot(y))<0.01 then local z=x:Cross(y)
if z.Magnitude>0.9 then rotations[#rotations+1]=CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero,x,y,z.Unit)
end end end end local function bestRotation(longAxis,thinAxis,gripSide)
local wantedLong=handle.CFrame.LookVector if gripSide>0 then wantedLong=-wantedLong end local wantedThin=handle.CFrame.UpVector local best,bestScore=CFrame.new(),-math.huge for _,cf in ipairs(rotations)do local longWorld=axisVector(cf,longAxis)
local thinWorld=axisVector(cf,thinAxis)
local score=longWorld:Dot(wantedLong)*10 score=score+math.abs(thinWorld:Dot(wantedThin))*2 if score>bestScore then bestScore=score best=cf end end return best end local function scaleModel(root,factor)

local rx,ry,rz=rel:ToOrientation()part.Size=Vector3.new(math.max(part.Size.X*factor,0.01),math.max(part.Size.Y*factor,0.01),math.max(part.Size.Z*factor,0.01))part.CFrame=bbox*CFrame.new(rel.Position*factor)*CFrame.Angles(rx,ry,rz)
end end local function moveBBox(root,target)

local delta=target*current:Inverse()
for _,part in ipairs(partsOf(root))do part.CFrame=delta*part.CFrame end end local function handGripPoint()

elseif obj:IsA("SpecialMesh")then rainbowOriginal[obj]={kind="mesh",VertexColor=obj.VertexColor}

elseif obj:IsA("PointLight")or obj:IsA("SpotLight")or obj:IsA("SurfaceLight")then rainbowOriginal[obj]={kind="color",Color=obj.Color}
elseif obj:IsA("Highlight")then rainbowOriginal[obj]={kind="highlight",FillColor=obj.FillColor,OutlineColor=obj.OutlineColor}

-- ==================== BAT AIMBOT OPTIONS (ported from 000duels) ====================
_G.__MonsterBatOpts = _G.__MonsterBatOpts or {
    equip=false, equipAim=false, equipV2=false,
    spam=false, spamAim=false, spamV2=false,
    tpDown=false, tpDownAim=false, tpDownV2=false,
    aimOnHit=false, detect=false, warn=false,
}
pcall(function()
    if _G.__MonsterBatOptsCleanup then pcall(_G.__MonsterBatOptsCleanup) end
    local O = _G.__MonsterBatOpts
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local LPl = Players.LocalPlayer
    local alive = true
    local conns = {}

    local function isBatName(n)
        if not n then return false end
        n = n:lower()
        return n:find("bat") or n:find("slap") or n:find("bast") or n:find("club") or n:find("taco") or n:find("sword") or n:find("hammer")
    end

    local function findBat()
        local char = LPl.Character
        if char then
            for _, tl in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if tl:IsA("Tool") and isBatName(tl.Name) then return tl end
            end
        end
        local bp = LPl:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        if bp then
            for _, tl in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
                if tl:IsA("Tool") and isBatName(tl.Name) then return tl end
            end
        end
        if _vxBat and type(_vxBat.getBat) == "function" then
            local b = _vxBat.getBat()
            if b then return b end
        end
        if char then
            local t = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if t then return t end
        end
        if bp then
            local t = bp:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if t then return t end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function hSpeed(plr)
        local c = plr and plr.Character
        local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not r then return 0 end
        local v = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity or r.Velocity
        if not v then return 0 end
        return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude
    end

    local function nearest()
        local c = LPl.Character
        local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not r then return nil end
        local best, bd
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LPl and p.Character then
                local pr = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local h = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if pr and h and h.Health > 0 then
                    local d = (pr.Position - r.Position).Magnitude
                    if not bd or d < bd then best, bd = p, d end
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end

    -- equip / spam / TP DOWN worker
    task.spawn(function()
        local lastSpam, lastTp = 0, 0
        while alive and task.wait(0.08) do
            local isV2 = autoBatBypassEnabled == true or autoBatV3Enabled == true
            local isAim = autoBatEnabled == true
            local equip = O.equip or (isV2 and O.equipV2) or (isAim and O.equipAim)
            local spam = O.spam or (isV2 and O.spamV2) or (isAim and O.spamAim)
            local tp = O.tpDown or (isV2 and O.tpDownV2) or (isAim and O.tpDownAim)

            if equip or spam or tp then
                local char = LPl.Character
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if char and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                    local bat = findBat()
                    if equip and bat and bat.Parent ~= char then
                        pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end)
                    end
                    if spam and bat and bat.Parent == char and tick() - lastSpam >= 0.08 then
                        lastSpam = tick()
                        pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
                        local remote = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent") or bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteFunction")
                        if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                            pcall(function() remote:FireServer() end)
                        end
                    end
                end
                if tp and tick() - lastTp >= 0.8 then
                    lastTp = tick()
                    if _G.__MonsterTpDown then pcall(_G.__MonsterTpDown) end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    -- Auto Aimbot Detected Anti Bat: switches Auto Bat <-> Bat Aimbot by target speed
    task.spawn(function()
        while alive and task.wait(0.12) do
            if O.detect and (autoBatEnabled or autoBatBypassEnabled or autoBatV3Enabled) then
                local tgt = nearest()
                if tgt then
                    local thresh = tonumber(O.laggerSpeed) or tonumber(_G.__MonsterAimLaggerSpeed) or 45
                    local fast = hSpeed(tgt) >= thresh
                    local bypassOn = autoBatBypassEnabled or autoBatV3Enabled
                    if fast and not bypassOn then
                        _G.__MonsterAutoSwitching = true
                        pcall(disableAutoBat)
                        pcall(enableBatBypass)
                        _G.__MonsterAutoSwitching = nil
                    elseif (not fast) and bypassOn and not autoBatEnabled then
                        _G.__MonsterAutoSwitching = true
                        pcall(disableBatBypass)
                        pcall(enableAutoBat)
                        _G.__MonsterAutoSwitching = nil
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    -- Warning Anti Bat banner
    local warned = {}
    local warnGui, warnFrame, warnToken = nil, nil, 0
    local function showWarn(plr)
        warnToken = warnToken + 1
        local token = warnToken
        if warnFrame then pcall(function() warnFrame:Destroy() end) warnFrame = nil end
        if not warnGui or not warnGui.Parent then
            warnGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            warnGui.Name = "MonsterAntiBatWarning"
            warnGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
            warnGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
            warnGui.DisplayOrder = 1000
            local ok = pcall(function() warnGui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
            if not ok or not warnGui.Parent then warnGui.Parent = LPl:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end
        end
        local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        warnFrame = frame
        frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
        frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 460, 0, 72)
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -90)
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
        frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        frame.ZIndex = 1000
        frame.Parent = warnGui
        Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 22)
        local st = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
        st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 125)
        local lb = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
        lb.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -10)
        lb.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 5)
        lb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lb.Text = "The Player " .. tostring(plr.DisplayName or plr.Name) .. " Is Using Anti Bat"
        lb.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        lb.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
        lb.TextSize = 17
        lb.TextWrapped = true
        lb.ZIndex = 1001
        TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.42, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 28)}):Play()
        task.delay(3, function()
            if token ~= warnToken or not frame.Parent then return end
            local o = TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -100)})
            o:Play(); o.Completed:Wait()
            if token == warnToken then frame:Destroy(); warnFrame = nil end
        end)
    end

    -- Auto Aim On Hit: when a nearby player ragdolls (gets hit) and recovers, start the aimbot
    local tracked = {}
    local function startOnHit(fast)
        if autoBatEnabled or autoBatBypassEnabled or autoBatV3Enabled then return end
        _G.__MonsterAutoSwitching = true
        if fast then pcall(enableBatBypass) else pcall(enableAutoBat) end
        _G.__MonsterAutoSwitching = nil
    end
    local function track(plr)
        if plr == LPl or tracked[plr] then return end
        tracked[plr] = true
        local function hook(char)
            local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
            if not hum then return end
            local was = false
            table.insert(conns, hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, new)
                if not O.aimOnHit then return end
                local rag = new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
                    or new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding
                if rag then
                    was = true
                elseif was then
                    was = false
                    local mc = LPl.Character
                    local mr = mc and mc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local pr = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if mr and pr and (mr.Position - pr.Position).Magnitude <= 45 then
                        local thresh = tonumber(O.laggerSpeed) or tonumber(_G.__MonsterAimLaggerSpeed) or 45
                        startOnHit(O.detect and hSpeed(plr) >= thresh)
                    end
                end
            end))
        end
        if plr.Character then task.spawn(hook, plr.Character) end
        table.insert(conns, plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.spawn(hook, c) end))
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do track(p) end
    table.insert(conns, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(track))

    task.spawn(function()
        while alive and task.wait(0.25) do
            if O.warn then
                local thresh = tonumber(O.laggerSpeed) or tonumber(_G.__MonsterAimLaggerSpeed) or 45
                for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if p ~= LPl then
                        local key = tonumber(p.UserId) or p.Name
                        if not warned[key] and hSpeed(p) >= thresh then
                            warned[key] = true
                            pcall(showWarn, p)
                            task.delay(10, function() warned[key] = nil end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    _G.__MonsterBatOptsCleanup = function()
        alive = false
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    end
end)

-- ==================== CONFUSER (ported from Lord Hub Confuser) ====================
_G.__MonsterConfuser = _G.__MonsterConfuser or {on = false, speed = 50, activeOnSteal = false}
pcall(function()
    if _G.__MonsterConfuserCleanup then pcall(_G.__MonsterConfuserCleanup) end
    local C = _G.__MonsterConfuser
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local LPl = Players.LocalPlayer
    local alive = true
    local spinConn, angle = nil, 0
    local antiDie = false
    local adConns, adCharAdded, adHeartbeat = {}, nil, nil
    local stealActive = false

    local function startSpin()
        if spinConn then return end
        angle = 0
        spinConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            if not C.on then return end
            local char = LPl.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root then return end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = false end) end
            angle = (angle + (tonumber(C.speed) or 50) * dt * 60) % 360
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(angle), 0)
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end)
    end
    local function stopSpin()
        if spinConn then spinConn:Disconnect(); spinConn = nil end
        local char = LPl.Character
        if char then
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = true end) end
            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then pcall(function() root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end) end
        end
    end
    local function clearEntry(char, restore)
        local e = adConns[char]
        if e then
            for _, k in ipairs({"healthConn", "diedConn", "cleanupConn"}) do
                if e[k] then pcall(function() e[k]:Disconnect() end) end
            end
            adConns[char] = nil
        end
        if restore and char and char.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum then
                    hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = true
                    hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    local function applyAntiDie(char)
        if not char or not char.Parent then return end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return end
        clearEntry(char, false)
        hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
        hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, false)
        local entry = {humanoid = hum}
        entry.healthConn = hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Health"):Connect(function()
            if antiDie and adConns[char] == entry and hum.Health <= 0 then hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth end
        end)
        entry.diedConn = hum.Died:Connect(function()
            task.defer(function()
                if antiDie and adConns[char] == entry and hum and hum.Parent then
                    hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
                    hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, false)
                    hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth
                end
            end)
        end)
        entry.cleanupConn = char.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
            if not char.Parent then clearEntry(char, false) end
        end)
        adConns[char] = entry
    end
    local function setAntiDie(on)
        on = on == true
        if on == antiDie then return end
        antiDie = on
        if on then
            if not adCharAdded then
                adCharAdded = LPl.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
                    task.wait(0.2)
                    if antiDie and char and char.Parent then applyAntiDie(char) end
                end)
            end
            local char = LPl.Character
            if char and char.Parent and not adConns[char] then applyAntiDie(char) end
            if not adHeartbeat then
                adHeartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    if not antiDie then return end
                    local c = LPl.Character
                    local hum = c and c.Parent and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if not hum then return end
                    local e = adConns[c]
                    if not e or e.humanoid ~= hum then applyAntiDie(c) end
                    if hum.BreakJointsOnDeath then hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = false end
                    if hum:GetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead) then hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, false) end
                    if hum.Health <= 0 then hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth end
                end)
            end
        else
            if adHeartbeat then adHeartbeat:Disconnect(); adHeartbeat = nil end
            for char in pairs(adConns) do clearEntry(char, true) end
        end
    end
    function C.set(on, fromSteal)
        C.on = on == true
        if not fromSteal then stealActive = false end
        setAntiDie(C.on)
        if C.on then startSpin() else stopSpin() end
        if C._setVisual then pcall(C._setVisual, C.on) end
    end
    local function carrying()
        local char = LPl.Character
        return LPl:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true or (char ~= nil and char:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true)
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        while alive and task.wait(0.15) do
            if C.activeOnSteal then
                local c = carrying()
                if c and not stealActive and not C.on then
                    stealActive = true
                    C.set(true, true)
                elseif not c and stealActive then
                    stealActive = false
                    C.set(false, true)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    _G.__MonsterConfuserCleanup = function()
        alive = false
        C.on = false
        stopSpin()
        setAntiDie(false)
    end
end)

MONSTER_HUB_FONT = nil
function loadMonsterHubFont()
local fontAssetGetter = getcustomasset or getsynasset
if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(fontAssetGetter) ~= "function" then return end
local fontPath, jsonPath = "Monter_Duels_Starborn.ttf", "Monter_Duels_Starborn.json"
local fontReady = false
if type(isfile) == "function" then pcall(function() fontReady = isfile(fontPath) end) end
if not fontReady then
local okDownload, data = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet("https://files.catbox.moe/pwgdui.ttf") end)
if not okDownload or type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 1000 then return end
if not pcall(writefile, fontPath, data) then return end
end
local okAsset, fontAsset = pcall(fontAssetGetter, fontPath)
if not okAsset or not fontAsset then return end
local okJson = pcall(function()
writefile(jsonPath, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({name = "Starborn", faces = {{name = "Regular", weight = 400, style = "normal", assetId = fontAsset}}}))
end)
if not okJson then return end
local okJsonAsset, jsonAsset = pcall(fontAssetGetter, jsonPath)
if not okJsonAsset or not jsonAsset then return end
local okFont, customFont = pcall(function() return Font.new(jsonAsset) end)
if not okFont or not customFont then return end
MONSTER_HUB_FONT = customFont
end
_G.__MonsterOrigFonts = _G.__MonsterOrigFonts or setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
function applyMonsterHubFont(root)
if not root then return end
local override = _G.__MonsterUIFontOverride
local orig = _G.__MonsterOrigFonts
if not override and not MONSTER_HUB_FONT and next(orig) == nil then return end
local function apply(obj)
if (obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox")) and obj:GetAttribute("MonsterFontPreview") ~= true then
pcall(function()
if override then
if orig[obj] == nil then orig[obj] = obj.FontFace end
obj.Font = override
elseif MONSTER_HUB_FONT then
obj.FontFace = MONSTER_HUB_FONT
orig[obj] = nil
elseif orig[obj] ~= nil then
obj.FontFace = orig[obj]
orig[obj] = nil
end
end)
end
end
apply(root)
for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do apply(d) end
end


local function applyHubBackground()
    local img = getBackgroundImage(backgroundIndex)
    if bgImage then
        if img == "" then
            bgImage.Image = ""
            bgImage.ImageTransparency = 1
        else
            bgImage.Image = img
            bgImage.ImageTransparency = backgroundImageTransparency or 0
            bgImage.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
        end
    end
    if main and main:FindFirstChild("BackgroundImage") then
        local bi = main.BackgroundImage
        if img == "" then bi.Image = ""; bi.ImageTransparency = 1
        else bi.Image = img; bi.ImageTransparency = backgroundImageTransparency or 0 end
    end
end

-- ===== Efeitos brilhantes da UI =====
function fxBorder(stroke)
    local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    g.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 125))
    g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.82),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, 0.82),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, 0.82),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.82),
    })
    g.Parent = stroke
    task.spawn(function()
        local rot = 0
        while g.Parent do
            local ui = stroke.Parent
            if ui and ui.Visible then
                rot = (rot + 6) % 360
                g.Rotation = rot
            end
            task.wait(0.06)
        end
    end)
    return g
end

function fxShineBar(parent, z, loopEvery)
    local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
    bar.Name = "FxShine"
    bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(0.22, 0, 2.2, 0)
    bar.Position = UDim2.new(-0.3, 0, 0.5, 0)
    bar.Rotation = 18
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    bar.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bar.Active = false
    bar.ZIndex = z
    local gr = Instance.new("UIGradient", bar)
    gr.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.86),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
    })
    bar.Parent = parent
    local TSv = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local function sweep()
        bar.Position = UDim2.new(-0.3, 0, 0.5, 0)
        TSv:Create(bar, TweenInfo.new(1.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {Position = UDim2.new(1.3, 0, 0.5, 0)}):Play()
    end
    if loopEvery then
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(math.random() * 2)
            while bar.Parent do
                if parent.Visible then sweep() end
                task.wait(loopEvery)
            end
        end)
    end
    return bar, sweep
end

-- ===== Glow chamativo atrás do título (mantém a imagem rbxassetid original) =====
function mkMonsterTitle(parent, z, maxSize, strokeW, shadowOff)
    local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.Name = "MonsterTitle"
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
    holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    holder.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -4)
    holder.ZIndex = z
    holder.Parent = parent

    local function mk(name, zi)
        local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        t.Name = name
        t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        t.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        t.Text = "VENOM"
        t.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
        t.TextScaled = true
        t.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        t.ZIndex = zi
        local c = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint", t)
        c.MaxTextSize = maxSize
        t.Parent = holder
        return t
    end

    -- glow externo
    local glow = mk("Glow", z)
    glow.TextTransparency = 0.55
    local gs = Instance.new("UIStroke", glow)
    gs.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    gs.Thickness = strokeW * 2.4
    gs.Transparency = 0.72

    -- sombra 3D
    local sh = mk("Shadow", z + 1)
    sh.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, shadowOff)
    sh.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 72)
    local ss = Instance.new("UIStroke", sh)
    ss.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 72)
    ss.Thickness = strokeW

    -- texto principal branco brilhante
    local main = mk("Main", z + 2)
    local ms = Instance.new("UIStroke", main)
    ms.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 165)
    ms.Thickness = strokeW * 0.6
    local g = Instance.new("UIGradient", main)
    g.Rotation = 90
    g.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 205)),
    })

    pcall(function()
        game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(gs, TweenInfo.new(1.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), {Transparency = 0.9}):Play()
    end)
    return holder
end

function mkMonsterGlow(img, z)
    local g = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    g.Name = "TitleGlow"
    g.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    g.Image = img.Image
    g.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    g.ImageTransparency = 0.6
    g.ScaleType = img.ScaleType
    g.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    g.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    g.Size = UDim2.new(1.08, 0, 1.08, 0)
    g.ZIndex = z
    g.Parent = img.Parent
    pcall(function()
        game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(g, TweenInfo.new(1.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), {ImageTransparency = 0.88, Size = UDim2.new(1.14, 0, 1.14, 0)}):Play()
    end)
    return g
end

do
    if _G.__donwOpenGui then pcall(function() _G.__donwOpenGui:Destroy() end) end

    local openGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    openGui.Name = "donwOpenLauncher"
    openGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    openGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    openGui.DisplayOrder = 2147483647
    openGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    -- Prefer PlayerGui (Android/mobile executors)
    local pg = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
    local parented = false
    if pg then parented = pcall(function() openGui.Parent = pg end) end
    if not parented then
        pcall(function() if syn and syn.protect_gui then syn.protect_gui(openGui) end end)
        pcall(function() openGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
    end
    openGui.Enabled = true
    _G.__donwOpenGui = openGui

    miniBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    miniBtn.Name = "OpenMenuButton"
    miniBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(138, 40)
    miniBtn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 80)
    miniBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    miniBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    miniBtn.ClipsDescendants = true
    miniBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    miniBtn.Text = ""
    miniBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    miniBtn.Active = true
    miniBtn.Visible = true
    miniBtn.ZIndex = 100
    miniBtn.Parent = openGui
    Instance.new("UICorner", miniBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local miniTitle = Instance.new("ImageLabel", miniBtn)
    miniTitle.Name = "TitleImage"
    miniTitle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    miniTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1.15, 0)
    miniTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    miniTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    miniTitle.Image = "rbxassetid://129744568686946"
    miniTitle.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    miniTitle.ZIndex = 101
    pcall(function() mkMonsterGlow(miniTitle, 100) end)

    local function forceOpenHub()
        if not main then return end
        pcall(function()
            if gui then
                gui.Enabled = true
                if not gui.Parent then
                    local pg = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 3)
                    local ok = pcall(function() gui.Parent = pg end)
                    if not ok or not gui.Parent then
                        pcall(function() if syn and syn.protect_gui then syn.protect_gui(gui) end end)
                        pcall(function() gui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        main.Visible = true
        main.Active = true
        -- keep current position if already placed; only reset if off-screen
        local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
        local ox = main.Position.X.Offset
        local oy = main.Position.Y.Offset
        if ox < -50 or oy < -50 or ox > vp.X or oy > vp.Y then
            main.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
        end
        mainOriginalPos = main.Position
        if miniBtn then miniBtn.Visible = true end
        -- soft open animation
        pcall(function()
            main.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
            TS:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                BackgroundTransparency = 0
            }):Play()
        end)
    end

    local function forceCloseHub()
        if main then
            pcall(function()
                TS:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
                }):Play()
            end)
            task.delay(0.12, function()
                if main then main.Visible = false; main.BackgroundTransparency = 0 end
            end)
        end
        if miniBtn then miniBtn.Visible = true end
    end

    _G.DonwToggleHub = function()
        if main and main.Visible then
            forceCloseHub()
        else
            forceOpenHub()
        end
    end
    showGui = forceOpenHub
    hideGui = forceCloseHub

    -- toggle on InputEnded if finger/mouse did not drag far (works on mobile + pc)
    local pressPos = nil
    local pressMoved = false
    miniBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            pressPos = input.Position
            pressMoved = false
        end
    end)
    miniBtn.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not pressPos then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            if (input.Position - pressPos).Magnitude > 12 then
                pressMoved = true
                -- drag
                local d = input.Position - pressPos
                local base = miniBtn.Position
                -- only update during move using absolute from press - simpler:
            end
        end
    end)
    miniBtn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        if pressPos and not pressMoved then
            _G.DonwToggleHub()
        end
        pressPos = nil
        pressMoved = false
    end)


    -- drag support separate
    local dragging, d0, p0 = false, nil, nil
    miniBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            d0 = input.Position
            p0 = miniBtn.Position
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging or not d0 then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        local delta = input.Position - d0
        if delta.Magnitude > 12 then pressMoved = true end
        local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800,600)
        local x = math.clamp(p0.X.Offset + delta.X, 4, vp.X - 180)
        local y = math.clamp(p0.Y.Offset + delta.Y, 4, vp.Y - 62)
        miniBtn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
    end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
end

end)

local function colorTabIcon(root, color)
if not root then return end
for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
if obj:IsA("Frame") and obj.Name == "IconInk" then
obj.BackgroundColor3 = color
end
if obj:IsA("UIStroke") then
obj.Color = color
end
end
end

local function drawTabIcon(parent, name, color, z)
local size = 18
local root = Instance.new("Frame")
root.Name = "SectionIcon"
root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
root.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -size / 2)
root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
root.ZIndex = z
root.Parent = parent
local function round(obj, r)
local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 2)
c.Parent = obj
end
local function line(x1, y1, x2, y2, thickness)
local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
local ink = Instance.new("Frame")
ink.Name = "IconInk"
ink.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
ink.Position = UDim2.fromScale((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2)
ink.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) * size, thickness or 1.7)
ink.BackgroundColor3 = color
ink.BorderSizePixel = 0
ink.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
ink.ZIndex = z
ink.Parent = root
round(ink, 2)
end
local function box(x, y, w, h, radius, solid)
local object = Instance.new("Frame")
object.Name = "IconInk"
object.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
object.Size = UDim2.fromScale(w, h)
object.BackgroundColor3 = color
object.BackgroundTransparency = solid and 0 or 1
object.BorderSizePixel = 0
object.ZIndex = z
object.Parent = root
round(object, radius or 2)
if not solid then
local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
st.Color = color
st.Thickness = 1.35
st.Transparency = 0
st.Parent = object
end
return object
end
-- Distinct geometric marks per tab (Rival-style language, different shapes)
if name == "Speed" then
line(0.16, 0.28, 0.48, 0.5); line(0.48, 0.5, 0.16, 0.72)
line(0.50, 0.18, 0.86, 0.5); line(0.86, 0.5, 0.50, 0.82)
elseif name == "Combat" then
line(0.22, 0.78, 0.50, 0.14); line(0.50, 0.14, 0.78, 0.78)
line(0.34, 0.58, 0.66, 0.58)
elseif name == "Visual" then
box(0.14, 0.14, 0.30, 0.30, 2, false)
box(0.56, 0.14, 0.30, 0.30, 2, true)
box(0.14, 0.56, 0.30, 0.30, 2, true)
box(0.56, 0.56, 0.30, 0.30, 2, false)
elseif name == "Styles" then
box(0.34, 0.12, 0.32, 0.32, 8, false)
line(0.18, 0.88, 0.26, 0.62); line(0.26, 0.62, 0.74, 0.62); line(0.74, 0.62, 0.82, 0.88)
elseif name == "Config" then
box(0.20, 0.20, 0.60, 0.60, 3, false)

elseif name == "Keybinds" then

local function setTabVisualState(btnFrame, active)
local vImg = btnFrame:FindFirstChild("TabVisual")
local vGlass = btnFrame:FindFirstChild("TabGlass")
local vLbl = btnFrame:FindFirstChild("TabLabel")
local vSt = btnFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
local vUnder = btnFrame:FindFirstChild("Underline")
local icon = btnFrame:FindFirstChild("SectionIcon")
local accent = getThemeColor and getThemeColor() or Color3.fromRGB(210, 242, 222)
if active then
if vLbl then vLbl.TextColor3 = WHITE end
if vGlass then
vGlass.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 34)
vGlass.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
end
if vImg then vImg.ImageTransparency = 0.35 end
if vSt then
vSt.Color = accent
vSt.Transparency = 0.05
vSt.Thickness = 1.8
end
if vUnder then vUnder.Visible = true; vUnder.BackgroundColor3 = accent end
colorTabIcon(icon, accent)
else
if vLbl then vLbl.TextColor3 = TAB_INACT end
if vGlass then
vGlass.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(9, 17, 12)
vGlass.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
end
if vImg then vImg.ImageTransparency = 0.72 end
if vSt then
vSt.Color = ROW_BORDER
vSt.Transparency = 0.55
vSt.Thickness = 1
end
if vUnder then vUnder.Visible = false end
colorTabIcon(icon, Color3.fromRGB(244, 244, 244))
end
end

-- ==================== TABS POSITION (Left / Down) ====================
do
local TAB_BAR_H = 46
local function applyTabPosition(position, silent)
position = (position == "Down") and "Down" or "Left"
_G.__MonsterTabPosition = position
local isDown = position == "Down"
local wraps = {}
for _, w in ipairs(tabBar:GetChildren()) do
if w:IsA("Frame") then table.insert(wraps, w) end
end
local visibleCount = 0
for _, w in ipairs(wraps) do
if w.Visible then visibleCount = visibleCount + 1 end
end
visibleCount = math.max(visibleCount, 1)
if isDown then
tabBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, TAB_BAR_H)
tabBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -(TAB_BAR_H + 10))
tabLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
tabLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
tabLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
tabLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
tabBarPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
tabBarPadding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4)
tabBarPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6)
tabBarPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
tabContent.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -(130 + TAB_BAR_H + 20))
tabContent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 130)
else
tabBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 112, 1, -138)
tabBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 128)
tabLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
tabLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
tabLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
tabLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
tabBarPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6)
tabBarPadding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6)
tabBarPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6)
tabBarPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
tabContent.Size = UDim2.new(1, -136, 1, -140)
tabContent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 128, 0, 130)
end
for _, w in ipairs(wraps) do
if isDown then
w.Size = UDim2.new(1 / visibleCount, -(4 * (visibleCount - 1)) / visibleCount, 1, 0)
else
w.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 42)
end
local b = w:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextButton")
if b then
local lbl = b:FindFirstChild("TabLabel")
local under = b:FindFirstChild("Underline")
if lbl then
if isDown then
lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -8)
lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 2)
lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
lbl.TextWrapped = true
else
lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
lbl.TextWrapped = false
end
end
if under then
if isDown then
under.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
under.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -3)
else
under.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
under.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -4)
end
end
end
end
if _G.__MonsterTabPositionLabel then
_G.__MonsterTabPositionLabel.Text = string.upper(position)
end
if not silent then pcall(saveAllSettings) end
return position
end
_G.__MonsterSetTabPosition = applyTabPosition
-- tabs can be shown/hidden later: re-flow the bar when that happens
for _, w in ipairs(tabBar:GetChildren()) do
if w:IsA("Frame") then
w:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
if _G.__MonsterSetTabPosition then pcall(_G.__MonsterSetTabPosition, _G.__MonsterTabPosition or "Left", true) end
end)
end
end
applyTabPosition(_G.__MonsterTabPosition or "Left", true)
end

pageCounters[page] = pageCounters[page] + 1
return pageCounters[page]
end

local function animPill(pill, dot, on)
local stroke = pill:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
local info = TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
TS:Create(dot, info, {
Position = on and UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, -6) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -6),
}):Play()
TS:Create(pill, info, {
BackgroundColor3 = on and getThemeColor() or Color3.fromRGB(9, 18, 12),
BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 0.2,
}):Play()
if stroke then
TS:Create(stroke, info, {
Color = on and getThemeColor() or ROW_BORDER,
Transparency = on and 0 or 0.45,
Thickness = on and 2.4 or 1,
}):Play()
end
end
local function mkSlider(row, minV, maxV, default, cb)
local W = 118
local track = Instance.new("Frame", row)
track.Size = UDim2.new(0, W, 0, 4)
track.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(W + 44), 0.5, -2)
track.BackgroundColor3 = INP
track.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
track.BorderSizePixel = 0
track.ZIndex = 8
Instance.new("UICorner", track).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
local fill = Instance.new("Frame", track)
fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
fill.BackgroundColor3 = getThemeColor()
fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
fill.ZIndex = 9
Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
local knob = Instance.new("Frame", track)
knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 13, 0, 13)
knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
knob.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
knob.ZIndex = 11
Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
local kStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", knob)
kStroke.Color = getThemeColor()
kStroke.Thickness = 2
local valLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
valLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 20)
valLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0.5, -10)
valLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
valLabel.Text = tostring(default)
valLabel.TextColor3 = WHITE
valLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
valLabel.TextSize = 11
valLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
valLabel.ZIndex = 9
local hit = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
hit.Size = UDim2.new(0, W + 16, 0, 26)
hit.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(W + 52), 0.5, -13)
hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
hit.Text = ""
hit.AutoButtonColor = false
hit.ZIndex = 12
local current = default
local function render(a)
a = _clamp(a, 0, 1)
fill.Size = UDim2.new(a, 0, 1, 0)
knob.Position = UDim2.new(a, 0, 0.5, 0)
fill.BackgroundColor3 = getThemeColor()
kStroke.Color = getThemeColor()
end
local function applyFromX(px)
local left = track.AbsolutePosition.X
local width = track.AbsoluteSize.X
if width <= 0 then width = W end
if left <= 0 then return end
local a = (px - left) / width
a = _clamp(a, 0, 1)
local v = _floor(minV + (maxV - minV) * a + 0.5)
current = v
valLabel.Text = tostring(v)
render(a)
if cb then pcall(cb, v) end
end
local dragging = false
hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging = true
_isDraggingButton = true
applyFromX(i.Position.X)
end
end)
hit.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging = false
_isDraggingButton = false
end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
if not dragging then return end
if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
applyFromX(i.Position.X)
end
end)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
if not dragging then return end
if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging = false
_isDraggingButton = false
end
end)
local function setValue(v)
v = _clamp(tonumber(v) or minV, minV, maxV)
current = v
valLabel.Text = tostring(v)
render((v - minV) / (maxV - minV))
end
setValue(default)
return setValue
end
local function mkToggle(page, txt, cb)
local row = mkRow(page, 38)
mkLabel(row, txt)
local pill, dot = mkPill(row, 48)
local on = false
local function sv(s) on = s; animPill(pill, dot, s) end
local clk = Instance.new("TextButton", pill)
clk.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
clk.BackgroundTransparency = 1
clk.Text = ""
clk.AutoButtonColor = false
clk.ZIndex = 10
clk:SetAttribute("MonsterNoSound", true)
clk.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
on = not on
sv(on)
pcall(function() if _G.__MonsterUISound then _G.__MonsterUISound(on and "on" or "off") end end)
local ok, err = pcall(cb, on)
if not ok then warn("[monster] toggle '" .. tostring(txt) .. "': " .. tostring(err)) end
end)
pcall(function()
_G.__MonsterToggleReg = _G.__MonsterToggleReg or {}
_G.__MonsterToggleReg[txt] = function()
on = not on
sv(on)
local ok2, err2 = pcall(cb, on)
if not ok2 then warn("[monster] keybind toggle '" .. tostring(txt) .. "': " .. tostring(err2)) end
end
end)
return sv
end

local function mkKeyButton(parent, kbEntry)
local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", parent)
btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 24)
btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -88, 0.5, -12)
btn.BackgroundColor3 = INP
btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
local function getLabel() return (kbEntry.gp and kbEntry.gp.Name) or (kbEntry.kb and kbEntry.kb.Name) or "None" end
btn.Text = getLabel()
btn.TextColor3 = WHITE
btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
btn.TextSize = 9
btn.ZIndex = 8
btn.AutoButtonColor = false
Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
local bs = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
bs.Color = ROW_BORDER
bs.Thickness = 1
local li = false; local lc; local pv = btn.Text; local listenStart = 0
btn.Activated:Connect(function()
if li then li = false; _anyKeyListening = false; if lc then lc:Disconnect(); lc = nil end; btn.Text = pv; btn.TextColor3 = WHITE; return end
pv = btn.Text; li = true; _anyKeyListening = true; listenStart = _tick(); btn.Text = "..."; btn.TextColor3 = WHITE
lc = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
if not li then return end
if inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then li = false; _anyKeyListening = false; if lc then lc:Disconnect(); lc = nil end; btn.Text = pv; btn.TextColor3 = WHITE; return end
local isGp = isGamepadInput(inp)
if isGp and _tick()-listenStart < 0.15 then return end
if not isBindableInput(inp) then return end
btn.Text = inp.KeyCode.Name; pv = inp.KeyCode.Name; btn.TextColor3 = WHITE
li = false; _anyKeyListening = false; if lc then lc:Disconnect(); lc = nil end
if isGp then kbEntry.gp = inp.KeyCode; kbEntry.kb = nil else kbEntry.kb = inp.KeyCode; kbEntry.gp = nil end
end)
end)
table.insert(keyButtonRefs, {btn = btn, entry = kbEntry})
return btn
end

end)

local cursorRgbGui = nil
local cursorRgbConnection = nil
function setCursorRgbEnabled(enabled)
    cursorRgbEnabled = enabled and true or false
    if enabled then
        if cursorRgbGui and cursorRgbGui.Parent then return end
        local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        if not player then return end
        local playerGui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        local oldCursor = playerGui:FindFirstChild("BloodHoundsCursorRGB")
        if oldCursor then oldCursor:Destroy() end

        cursorRgbGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        cursorRgbGui.Name = "BloodHoundsCursorRGB"
        cursorRgbGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        cursorRgbGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        cursorRgbGui.DisplayOrder = 100000
        cursorRgbGui.Parent = playerGui

        local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
        ring.Name = "RgbCursorRing"
        ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        ring.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34)
        ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        ring.BorderSizePixel = 0
        ring.Parent = cursorRgbGui

        local dots = {}
        local dotCount = 36
        local radius = 11.5
        for i = 1, dotCount do
            local angle = ((i - 1) / dotCount) * math.pi * 2
            local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
            dot.Name = "RgbDot"
            dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            dot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(angle) * radius, 0.5, math.sin(angle) * radius)
            dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4)
            dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
            dot.Parent = ring
            local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            corner.Parent = dot
            dots[i] = dot
        end

        local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
        cursorRgbConnection = runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local hue = (os.clock() * 0.22) % 1
            for i, dot in ipairs(dots) do
                dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV((hue + (i - 1) / dotCount) % 1, 1, 1)
            end
        end)
        _G.BloodHoundsCursorRGBConnection = cursorRgbConnection
    else
        if cursorRgbConnection then
            cursorRgbConnection:Disconnect()
            cursorRgbConnection = nil
        end
        if _G.BloodHoundsCursorRGBConnection then
            _G.BloodHoundsCursorRGBConnection = nil
        end
        if cursorRgbGui then
            cursorRgbGui:Destroy()
            cursorRgbGui = nil
        end
    end
end

-- ==================== KORBLOX / HEADLESS (visual) ====================
task.spawn(function()
local okK9, errK9 = pcall(function()
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE = function(f) return f end
local toggleStates = { ["Korblox Visual"] = false, ["Headless Visual"] = false }
local FeaturePostToggle = {}
local K9_FILE = "Monster_Appearance.json"
local function saveConfig()
	if type(writefile) ~= "function" then return end
	pcall(function()
		writefile(K9_FILE, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({
			korblox = toggleStates["Korblox Visual"] == true,
			headless = toggleStates["Headless Visual"] == true,
		}))
	end)
end
pcall(function()
	if type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and isfile(K9_FILE) then
		local d = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile(K9_FILE))
		if type(d) == "table" then
			toggleStates["Korblox Visual"] = d.korblox == true
			toggleStates["Headless Visual"] = d.headless == true
		end
	end
end)
local function setFeature(name, value)
	toggleStates[name] = value == true
	local f = FeaturePostToggle[name]
	if f then pcall(f, value == true) end
	for _, listener in ipairs(_G.__MonsterAppearanceListeners or {}) do pcall(listener, name, value == true) end
	saveConfig()
end
if type(_G.__CrystalTrackConn) ~= "function" then _G.__CrystalTrackConn = function(c) return c end end
if type(_G.__CrystalTrackStopper) ~= "function" then _G.__CrystalTrackStopper = function() end end
	do
	local appearanceState = _G.__CrystalVisualAppearanceState
	if type(appearanceState) ~= "table" or appearanceState.version ~= 2 then
		appearanceState = {
			version = 2,
			headless = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
			korblox = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
		}
		_G.__CrystalVisualAppearanceState = appearanceState
	end
	appearanceState.setHeadless = function(active, character)
		character = character or Player.Character
		local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if not head or not head:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
		if active then
			if not appearanceState.headless[character] then
				local saved = {headTransparency = head.Transparency, headLocalTransparency = head.LocalTransparencyModifier, faces = {}}
				for _, item in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
					if item:IsA("Decal") or item:IsA("Texture") then
						table.insert(saved.faces, {item = item, transparency = item.Transparency})
					end
				end
				appearanceState.headless[character] = saved
			end
			head.Transparency = 1
			head.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
			for _, item in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
				if item:IsA("Decal") or item:IsA("Texture") then item.Transparency = 1 end
			end
			return true
		end
		local saved = appearanceState.headless[character]
		if not saved then return false end
		head.Transparency = saved.headTransparency
		head.LocalTransparencyModifier = saved.headLocalTransparency
		for _, face in ipairs(saved.faces) do
			if face.item and face.item.Parent then face.item.Transparency = face.transparency end
		end
		return true
	end
	appearanceState.setKorblox = function(active, character)
		character = character or Player.Character
		if not character then return false end
		local saved = appearanceState.korblox[character]
		if not active then
			local oldVisual = character:FindFirstChild("CrystalVisual_Korblox")
			if oldVisual then pcall(function() oldVisual:Destroy() end) end
			for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("CharacterMesh") and child.Name == "CrystalVisual_KorbloxCharacterMesh" then
					pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
				end
			end
			if not saved then return false end
			for _, partState in ipairs(saved.parts) do
				if partState.part and partState.part.Parent then
					partState.part.Transparency = partState.transparency
					partState.part.LocalTransparencyModifier = partState.localTransparency
				end
			end
			return true
		end
		local target = character:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperLeg") or character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
		if not target or not target:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
		local ok, objects = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://139607673") end)
		if not ok or not objects or not objects[1] then
			warn("Crystal Korblox: no se pudo cargar el asset 139607673")
			return false
		end
		local oldVisual = character:FindFirstChild("CrystalVisual_Korblox")
		if oldVisual then pcall(function() oldVisual:Destroy() end) end
		for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("CharacterMesh") and child.Name == "CrystalVisual_KorbloxCharacterMesh" then
				pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
			end
		end
		local visual = Instance.new("Model")
		visual.Name = "CrystalVisual_Korblox"
		for _, object in ipairs(objects) do object.Parent = visual end
		local importedParts = {}
		for _, descendant in ipairs(visual:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(importedParts, descendant) end
		end
		local characterMeshes = {}
		for _, descendant in ipairs(visual:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("CharacterMesh") then table.insert(characterMeshes, descendant) end
		end
		if #importedParts == 0 and #characterMeshes == 0 then
			visual:Destroy()
			warn("Crystal Korblox: el asset 139607673 no contiene piezas compatibles")
			return false
		end
		if not saved then
			saved = {parts = {}}
			for _, partName in ipairs({"LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot", "Left Leg"}) do
				local part = character:FindFirstChild(partName)
				if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
					table.insert(saved.parts, {part = part, transparency = part.Transparency, localTransparency = part.LocalTransparencyModifier})
				end
			end
			appearanceState.korblox[character] = saved
		end
		visual.Parent = character
		local isR15 = character:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperLeg") ~= nil
		if isR15 then
			for _, partState in ipairs(saved.parts) do
				if partState.part and partState.part.Parent then
					partState.part.Transparency = 1
					partState.part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
				end
			end
		end
		for _, part in ipairs(importedParts) do
			local matchingTarget = character:FindFirstChild(part.Name)
			if not matchingTarget or not matchingTarget:IsA("BasePart") then matchingTarget = target end
			part.Anchored = false
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.Massless = true
			part.CFrame = matchingTarget.CFrame
			local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
			weld.Part0 = matchingTarget
			weld.Part1 = part
			weld.Parent = part
		end
		for _, mesh in ipairs(characterMeshes) do
			mesh.Name = "CrystalVisual_KorbloxCharacterMesh"
			mesh.Parent = character
		end
		return true
	end
	FeaturePostToggle["Headless Visual"] = function(active)
		appearanceState.setHeadless(active == true, Player.Character)
	end
	FeaturePostToggle["Korblox Visual"] = function(active)
		task.spawn(appearanceState.setKorblox, active == true, Player.Character)
	end
	_G.__CrystalTrackConn(Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		task.wait(0.75)
		if toggleStates["Headless Visual"] then appearanceState.setHeadless(true, character) end
		if toggleStates["Korblox Visual"] then appearanceState.setKorblox(true, character) end
	end))
	if toggleStates["Headless Visual"] then task.delay(0.5, appearanceState.setHeadless, true, Player.Character) end
	if toggleStates["Korblox Visual"] then task.delay(0.5, appearanceState.setKorblox, true, Player.Character) end
	end
_G._MonsterK9SetKorblox = function(on) setFeature("Korblox Visual", on == true) end
_G._MonsterK9SetHeadless = function(on) setFeature("Headless Visual", on == true) end
_G.__MonsterK9Set = function(name, on) setFeature(name, on == true) end
_G.__MonsterK9Get = function(name) return toggleStates[name] == true end
end)
if not okK9 then warn("[K9 Skins] " .. tostring(errK9)) end
end)

    a = _clamp(a, 0, 1)

    fill.Size = UDim2.new(a, 0, 1, 0)
    halo.Position = UDim2.new(a, 0, 0.5, 0)

    halo.BackgroundColor3 = c

    badge.BackgroundColor3 = c
    badgeStroke.Color = c
end
local function setValue(v)
    v = _clamp(_floor((tonumber(v) or FOV_DEFAULT) + 0.5), FOV_MIN, FOV_MAX)
    badgeLbl.Text = tostring(v) .. "°"
    render((v - FOV_MIN) / (FOV_MAX - FOV_MIN))
    return v
end
local function applyFromX(px)
    local left = track.AbsolutePosition.X
    local width = track.AbsoluteSize.X
    if width <= 0 then return end
    local a = _clamp((px - left) / width, 0, 1)
    local v = setValue(FOV_MIN + (FOV_MAX - FOV_MIN) * a)
    fovValue = v
    if not fovEnabled then
        enableCustomFov()
        if setFovVisual then setFovVisual(true) end
    end
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam then pcall(function() cam.FieldOfView = fovValue end) end
    pcall(saveAllSettings)
end
local dragging = false
local function stopDrag()
    dragging = false
    _isDraggingButton = false
    TS:Create(halo, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 26), BackgroundTransparency = 0.8}):Play()
end
hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        _isDraggingButton = true
        TS:Create(halo, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 32), BackgroundTransparency = 0.65}):Play()
        applyFromX(i.Position.X)
    end
end)

    if not dragging then return end
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        applyFromX(i.Position.X)
    end
end)

    if not dragging then return end
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then stopDrag() end
end)

-- ==================== SETS TAB (ported from Vynx Duels: Appearance / Animations / Avatar Panel) ====================

local setsPage = contentPages["Styles"]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

-- clean up a previous run of this block (re-execution)
if _G.__MonsterSetsRuntime and _G.__MonsterSetsRuntime.Destroy then pcall(_G.__MonsterSetsRuntime.Destroy) end
local sConns, sStoppers = {}, {}
local function trackConn(c) sConns[#sConns + 1] = c; return c end
local function trackStopper(f) sStoppers[#sStoppers + 1] = f end
_G.__MonsterSetsRuntime = {
	Destroy = function()
		for _, c in ipairs(sConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
		for _, f in ipairs(sStoppers) do pcall(f) end
		pcall(function()
			local p = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("MonsterAvatarPanel")
			if p then p:Destroy() end
		end)
	end,
}

-- ---------- saved settings ----------
local SAVE_FILE = "MonsterHub_Sets.json"
local saved = {}
pcall(function()
	if type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and isfile(SAVE_FILE) then
		local decoded = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(SAVE_FILE))
		if type(decoded) == "table" then saved = decoded end
	end
end)

local violetteSkinMode = tostring(saved.skinMode or "1")
local customAnimationIds = type(saved.customIds) == "table" and saved.customIds or {}
_G.__CrystalCustomAnimationIds = customAnimationIds
_G.__CrystalAnimationPreset = tostring(saved.animPreset or "")

local toggleStates = {
	["Corpo R15"] = saved.corpoR15 == true,
	["Violette Custom Skins"] = saved.customSkins == true,
	["Animations"] = saved.animations == true,
}
-- Headless / Korblox live in the existing visual-appearance block; read them through it
setmetatable(toggleStates, {
	__index = function(_, key)
		if (key == "Headless Visual" or key == "Korblox Visual") and _G.__MonsterK9Get then
			return _G.__MonsterK9Get(key) == true
		end
		return nil
	end,
})
local FeaturePostToggle = {}
local toggleVisualUpdaters = {}

local function saveConfig()
	if type(writefile) ~= "function" then return end
	pcall(function()
		writefile(SAVE_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode({
			corpoR15 = toggleStates["Corpo R15"] == true,
			customSkins = toggleStates["Violette Custom Skins"] == true,
			skinMode = violetteSkinMode,
			animations = toggleStates["Animations"] == true,
			animPreset = tostring(_G.__CrystalAnimationPreset or ""),
			customIds = customAnimationIds,
		}))
	end)
end

local function setFeature(featureName, state)
	state = state == true
	if featureName == "Headless Visual" or featureName == "Korblox Visual" then
		if _G.__MonsterK9Set then pcall(_G.__MonsterK9Set, featureName, state) end
		return
	end
	if toggleStates[featureName] == state then return end
	toggleStates[featureName] = state
	if FeaturePostToggle[featureName] then pcall(FeaturePostToggle[featureName], state) end
	if toggleVisualUpdaters[featureName] then pcall(toggleVisualUpdaters[featureName]) end
	saveConfig()
