-- Somente estes outfits ficam disponiveis no painel de skins
local VIOLETTE_ALLOWED = {
	["BLUE"] = true, ["BLACK"] = true, ["GREEN"] = true,
	["MK OUTFIT 5"] = true, ["MK OUTFIT 6"] = true, ["MK OUTFIT 7"] = true, ["MK OUTFIT 8"] = true,
	["NEW OUTFIT"] = true, ["NEW OUTFIT 2"] = true, ["NEW OUTFIT 3"] = true, ["NEW OUTFIT 4"] = true, ["NEW OUTFIT 5"] = true, ["NEW OUTFIT 6"] = true,
	["NOVA SKIN"] = true,
}
for key, skin in pairs(VIOLETTE_SKIN_SETS) do
	if not VIOLETTE_ALLOWED[tostring(skin.displayName)] then VIOLETTE_SKIN_SETS[key] = nil end
end
local VIOLETTE_DEFAULT_KEY
do
	local best, bestN
	for key, skin in pairs(VIOLETTE_SKIN_SETS) do
		local n = tonumber(key) or math.huge
		if not bestN or n < bestN then best, bestN = key, n end
	end
	VIOLETTE_DEFAULT_KEY = best or "1"
	_G.__MonsterDefaultSkinKey = VIOLETTE_DEFAULT_KEY
	if not VIOLETTE_SKIN_SETS[tostring(violetteSkinMode)] then violetteSkinMode = VIOLETTE_DEFAULT_KEY end
end
local function getVioletteSkinSet(mode)
	return VIOLETTE_SKIN_SETS[tostring(mode or "1")]
end
local function refreshVioletteSkinCatalog()
	local activeSets = {}
	local order = {}
	for key, skin in pairs(VIOLETTE_SKIN_SETS) do
		activeSets[key] = skin
		table.insert(order, key)
	end
	table.sort(order, function(a, b)
		return (tonumber(a) or math.huge) < (tonumber(b) or math.huge)
	end)
	_G._KawatanSkinSets = activeSets
	_G._KawatanSkinSetOrder = order
	return activeSets
end
refreshVioletteSkinCatalog()

	do
		local assetProperties = {
			[11] = "Shirt", [12] = "Pants", [2] = "GraphicTShirt",
			[8] = "HatAccessory", [41] = "HairAccessory", [42] = "FaceAccessory",
			[43] = "NeckAccessory", [44] = "ShouldersAccessory", [45] = "FrontAccessory",
			[46] = "BackAccessory", [47] = "WaistAccessory", [64] = "TShirtAccessory",
			[65] = "ShirtAccessory", [66] = "PantsAccessory", [67] = "JacketAccessory",
			[68] = "SweaterAccessory", [69] = "ShortsAccessory", [70] = "LeftShoeAccessory",
			[71] = "RightShoeAccessory", [72] = "DressSkirtAccessory",
		}
		local function addPreviewAsset(description, assetId)
			local ok, info = pcall(function()
				return game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(assetId, Enum.InfoType.Asset)
			end)
			if not ok or not info then return end
			local property = assetProperties[tonumber(info.AssetTypeId)]
			if not property then return end
			if property == "Shirt" or property == "Pants" or property == "GraphicTShirt" then
				pcall(function() description[property] = assetId end)
			else
				local current = ""
				pcall(function() current = tostring(description[property] or "") end)
				pcall(function() description[property] = current == "" and tostring(assetId) or (current .. "," .. tostring(assetId)) end)
			end
		end
		_G._KawatanBuildSetDescription = function(setName)
			local skin = getVioletteSkinSet(setName)
			if not skin then return nil end
			local base
			pcall(function()
				local hum = Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if hum then base = hum:GetAppliedDescription() end
			end)
			local description = base and base:Clone() or Instance.new("HumanoidDescription")
			for _, property in ipairs({"HatAccessory", "HairAccessory", "FaceAccessory", "NeckAccessory", "ShouldersAccessory", "FrontAccessory", "BackAccessory", "WaistAccessory", "ShirtAccessory", "PantsAccessory", "JacketAccessory", "SweaterAccessory", "ShortsAccessory", "TShirtAccessory", "DressSkirtAccessory"}) do pcall(function() description[property] = "" end) end
			pcall(function() description.Shirt = 0; description.Pants = 0; description.GraphicTShirt = 0 end)
			pcall(function()
				description.HatAccessory = skin.hats or ""
				description.HairAccessory = skin.hair or ""
				if skin.head then description.Head = skin.head end
				if skin.face then description.Face = skin.face end
				for property, value in pairs(skin.scales or {}) do description[property] = value end
			end)
			for _, id in ipairs(skin.accessories or {}) do addPreviewAsset(description, id) end
			for _, id in ipairs(skin.clothing or {}) do addPreviewAsset(description, id) end
			return description
		end
	end

	do
	local ok_, err_ = pcall(function()
	do
	local originals=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
	local hiddenSkinParts=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
	local generation=0
	local enabled=false
	local function restoreSkinParts(c)
		local saved=c and hiddenSkinParts[c]
		if not saved then return end
		for part,props in pairs(saved) do
			if part and part.Parent then pcall(function() part.Transparency=props.Transparency; part.LocalTransparencyModifier=props.LocalTransparencyModifier end) end
		end
		hiddenSkinParts[c]=nil
	end
	local function applySkinLegHides(c,skin)
		if not c then return end
		local names={}
		if skin.hideLeftLeg then for _,n in ipairs({"LeftUpperLeg","LeftLowerLeg","LeftFoot","Left Leg","LeftToe"}) do names[#names+1]=n end end
		if skin.hideRightLeg then for _,n in ipairs({"RightUpperLeg","RightLowerLeg","RightFoot","Right Leg","RightToe"}) do names[#names+1]=n end end
		if #names==0 then return end
		local saved={}; hiddenSkinParts[c]=saved
		for _,name in ipairs(names) do local part=c:FindFirstChild(name); if part and part:IsA("BasePart") and not saved[part] then saved[part]={Transparency=part.Transparency,LocalTransparencyModifier=part.LocalTransparencyModifier}; part.Transparency=1; part.LocalTransparencyModifier=1 end end
	end
	local function mark(o) pcall(function() o:SetAttribute("_CrystalVioletteSkin",true) end); return o end
	local function clearObjects(c)
		if not c then return end
		for _,o in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do if o:GetAttribute("_CrystalVioletteSkin") then pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end end
	end
	local function clearAccessories(c)
		if not c then return end
		for _,o in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do if o:IsA("Accessory") or o:IsA("Accoutrement") then pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end end
	end
	local function attach(c,h,a)
		if not a or not a:IsA("Accessory") then return false end
		mark(a); pcall(function() h:AddAccessory(a) end); if a.Parent~=c then a.Parent=c end
		local handle=a:FindFirstChild("Handle"); if not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then return a.Parent==c end
		local ha=handle:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Attachment"); if not ha then return a.Parent==c end
		local ba
		for _,o in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do if o:IsA("Attachment") and o.Name==ha.Name and not o:IsDescendantOf(a) then ba=o; break end end
		local bp=ba and ba.Parent
		if bp and bp:IsA("BasePart") then
			handle.Anchored=false; handle.CanCollide=false; handle.CanTouch=false; handle.CanQuery=false; handle.Massless=true
			handle.CFrame=bp.CFrame*ba.CFrame*ha.CFrame:Inverse()
			local w=Instance.new("WeldConstraint"); w.Name="CrystalVioletteAccessoryWeld"; w.Part0=bp; w.Part1=handle; w.Parent=handle
		end
		return true
	end
	local function addAsset(c,h,id)
		local ok,objs=pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..tostring(id)) end)
		if not ok or type(objs)~="table" or #objs==0 then local x; local q=pcall(function() x=game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(id) end); if q and x then objs={x} else return false end end
		local added=false
		for _,root in ipairs(objs) do
			local list={}
			if root:IsA("Accessory") or root:IsA("Shirt") or root:IsA("Pants") or root:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or root:IsA("CharacterMesh") then list={root} else for _,o in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do if o:IsA("Accessory") or o:IsA("Shirt") or o:IsA("Pants") or o:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or o:IsA("CharacterMesh") then table.insert(list,o) end end end
			for _,src in ipairs(list) do
				local x=mark(src:Clone())
				if x:IsA("Accessory") then attach(c,h,x) else for _,old in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do if old.ClassName==x.ClassName then old:Destroy() end end; x.Parent=c end
				added=true
			end
			pcall(function() root:Destroy() end)
		end
		return added
	end
	local function headless(c,on)
		local head=c and c:FindFirstChild("Head"); if not head then return end
		local t=on and 1 or 0; head.Transparency=t; head.LocalTransparencyModifier=t
		for _,o in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do if o:IsA("Decal") or o:IsA("Texture") then o.Transparency=t end end
	end
	local function apply(c)
		local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); if not h then return false end
		generation=generation+1; local token=generation; clearObjects(c); restoreSkinParts(c)
		local old; pcall(function() old=h:GetAppliedDescription() end); if old and not originals[c] then originals[c]=old:Clone() end
		clearAccessories(c)
		if old then
			local d=old:Clone()
			for _,p in ipairs({"HatAccessory","HairAccessory","FaceAccessory","NeckAccessory","ShouldersAccessory","FrontAccessory","BackAccessory","WaistAccessory","ShirtAccessory","PantsAccessory","JacketAccessory","SweaterAccessory","ShortsAccessory","TShirtAccessory","DressSkirtAccessory"}) do pcall(function() d[p]="" end) end
			pcall(function() d.Shirt=0; d.Pants=0; d.GraphicTShirt=0 end)
			local skin=getVioletteSkinSet(violetteSkinMode) or VIOLETTE_SKIN_SETS[VIOLETTE_DEFAULT_KEY]
			pcall(function()
				d.HatAccessory=skin.hats or ""; d.HairAccessory=skin.hair or ""
				if skin.head then d.Head=skin.head end
				if skin.face then d.Face=skin.face end
				for property,value in pairs(skin.scales or {}) do d[property]=value end
				h:ApplyDescription(d)
			end); d:Destroy()
		end
		task.wait(); if not enabled or token~=generation or not c.Parent then return false end
		local skin=getVioletteSkinSet(violetteSkinMode) or VIOLETTE_SKIN_SETS[VIOLETTE_DEFAULT_KEY]
		for _,id in ipairs(skin.accessories or {}) do addAsset(c,h,id) end
		for _,id in ipairs(skin.clothing or {}) do addAsset(c,h,id) end
		headless(c,skin.headless==true); applySkinLegHides(c,skin); return true
	end
	local function clear(c)
		generation=generation+1; c=c or Player.Character; if not c then return end; clearObjects(c); restoreSkinParts(c)
		local h=c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); local old=originals[c]
		if h and old then pcall(function() h:ApplyDescription(old:Clone()) end) else headless(c,false) end
	end
	FeaturePostToggle["Violette Custom Skins"]=function(on) enabled=on==true; if enabled then task.spawn(apply,Player.Character) else clear(Player.Character) end end
	_G._KawatanSkinColor = violetteSkinMode
	_G.__CrystalVioletteSkinSet=function(mode)
		mode=tostring(mode); if not getVioletteSkinSet(mode) then return violetteSkinMode end
		violetteSkinMode=mode; _G._KawatanSkinColor=mode; if enabled then task.spawn(apply,Player.Character) end; saveConfig(); return mode
	end
	trackConn(Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) if enabled then task.wait(.75); if enabled then task.spawn(apply,c) end end end))
	trackStopper(function() enabled=false; clear(Player.Character) end)
	if toggleStates["Violette Custom Skins"] then
		enabled=true
		task.defer(apply, Player.Character)
	end
	end

	end)
	if not ok_ then warn("[Sets:CustomSkins] " .. tostring(err_)) end
	end
	do
	local ok_, err_ = pcall(function()
	do
		-- CORPO R15 (substitui o antigo Vynx Skin): aplica o corpo/bundle 150255110427123
		local BODY_ID = 150255110427123
		local BODY_PROPS = {
			[17] = "Head", [79] = "Head", [27] = "Torso", [28] = "RightArm",
			[29] = "LeftArm", [30] = "LeftLeg", [31] = "RightLeg",
		}
		local enabled = false
		local bodyPieces -- {property = assetId}
		local origDesc = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
		local ACC_PROPS = {
			[8] = "HatAccessory", [41] = "HairAccessory", [42] = "FaceAccessory", [43] = "NeckAccessory",
			[44] = "ShouldersAccessory", [45] = "FrontAccessory", [46] = "BackAccessory", [47] = "WaistAccessory",
			[64] = "TShirtAccessory", [65] = "ShirtAccessory", [66] = "PantsAccessory", [67] = "JacketAccessory",
			[68] = "SweaterAccessory", [69] = "ShortsAccessory", [70] = "LeftShoeAccessory",
			[71] = "RightShoeAccessory", [72] = "DressSkirtAccessory",
		}
		local resolved -- {bodyProps = {prop=id}, accProps = {prop=id}, typeId = n}
		local function resolve()
			if resolved then return resolved end
			resolved = {bodyProps = {}, accProps = {}}
			local MP = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
			local function addAssetId(id)
				local ok, info = pcall(function() return MP:GetProductInfo(id, Enum.InfoType.Asset) end)
				if ok and info then
					local tid = tonumber(info.AssetTypeId)
					resolved.typeId = resolved.typeId or tid
					if BODY_PROPS[tid] then resolved.bodyProps[BODY_PROPS[tid]] = id; return true end
					if ACC_PROPS[tid] then resolved.accProps[ACC_PROPS[tid]] = id; return true end
				end
				return false
			end
			if not addAssetId(BODY_ID) then
				local ok, details = pcall(function() return game:GetService("AssetService"):GetBundleDetailsAsync(BODY_ID) end)
				if ok and type(details) == "table" and type(details.Items) == "table" then
					for _, item in ipairs(details.Items) do
						if item.Type == "Asset" then addAssetId(item.Id) end
					end
				end
			end
			return resolved
		end
		local R15_PARTS = {
			"Head", "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso", "LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm", "LeftHand",
			"RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm", "RightHand", "LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot",
			"RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot",
		}
		-- fallback: carrega o asset e aplica mesh/textura nas partes R15 (ou acessorios)
		local function applyLoaded(c, hum)
			local ok, objs = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(BODY_ID)) end)
			if not ok or type(objs) ~= "table" or #objs == 0 then
				local x
				local q = pcall(function() x = game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(BODY_ID) end)
				if q and x then objs = {x} else return false end
			end
			local did = false
			for _, root in ipairs(objs) do
				local nodes = {root}
				for _, o in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do nodes[#nodes + 1] = o end
				for _, o in ipairs(nodes) do
					if o:IsA("Accessory") then
						local a = o:Clone()
						a:SetAttribute("_CorpoR15", true)
						pcall(function() hum:AddAccessory(a) end)
						if not a.Parent then a.Parent = c end
						did = true
					elseif o:IsA("MeshPart") and table.find(R15_PARTS, o.Name) then
						local target = c:FindFirstChild(o.Name)
						if target and target:IsA("MeshPart") then
							pcall(function()
								target.MeshId = o.MeshId
								if o.TextureID ~= "" then target.TextureID = o.TextureID end
								for _, ch in ipairs(target:GetChildren()) do
									if ch:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then ch:Destroy() end
								end
								for _, ch in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
									if ch:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
										local sa = ch:Clone(); sa:SetAttribute("_CorpoR15", true); sa.Parent = target
									end
								end
							end)
							did = true
						end
					end
				end
				pcall(function() root:Destroy() end)
			end
			return did
		end
		local function applyChar(c)
			if not c then return end
			local hum = c:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
			if not hum or not enabled or not c.Parent then return end
			local r = resolve()
			local ok, cur = pcall(function() return hum:GetAppliedDescription() end)
			if not ok or not cur then return end
			if not origDesc[c] then origDesc[c] = cur:Clone() end
			local used = false
			for prop, id in pairs(r.bodyProps) do pcall(function() cur[prop] = id end); used = true end
			for prop, id in pairs(r.accProps) do
				pcall(function()
					local old = tostring(cur[prop] or "")
					cur[prop] = old == "" and tostring(id) or (old .. "," .. tostring(id))
				end)
				used = true
			end
			if used then pcall(function() hum:ApplyDescription(cur) end) end
			pcall(function() cur:Destroy() end)
			if not used then
				local did = applyLoaded(c, hum)
				if not did then warn("[Corpo R15] nao consegui aplicar o asset " .. tostring(BODY_ID) .. " (tipo " .. tostring(r.typeId) .. ")") end
			end
		end
		local function restoreChar(c)
			local d = c and origDesc[c]
			if not d then return end
			origDesc[c] = nil
			for _, o in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
				if o:GetAttribute("_CorpoR15") then pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end
			end
			local hum = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then pcall(function() hum:ApplyDescription(d) end) end
			pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
		end
		FeaturePostToggle["Corpo R15"] = function(on)
			enabled = on == true
			local c = Player.Character
			if enabled then task.spawn(applyChar, c) else restoreChar(c) end
		end
		trackConn(Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
			if not enabled then return end
			task.wait(1)
			if enabled then task.spawn(applyChar, c) end
		end))
		trackStopper(function() enabled = false; restoreChar(Player.Character) end)
		if toggleStates["Corpo R15"] then
			enabled = true
			task.defer(applyChar, Player.Character)
		end
	end

	end)
	if not ok_ then warn("[Sets:CorpoR15] " .. tostring(err_)) end
	end

	local animationChoiceNames = {}
	for _, presetName in ipairs(animationPresetOrder) do
		if animationPresets[presetName] then table.insert(animationChoiceNames, presetName) end
	end
	table.insert(animationChoiceNames, "Custom")

		or (type(_G.__VynxNamedAnimationPresets) == "table" and _G.__VynxNamedAnimationPresets)
		or {}

	_G.__CrystalCustomAnimationIds = customAnimationIds
	local selectedSourcePreset = tostring(_G.__CrystalAnimationPreset or "")
	local selectedChoiceIndex = 1
	for i, choice in ipairs(animationChoiceNames) do
		if choice == selectedSourcePreset then selectedChoiceIndex = i break end
	end
	if selectedSourcePreset == "" or (selectedChoiceIndex == 1 and animationChoiceNames[1] ~= selectedSourcePreset) then
		-- try exact match again; else default first named preset
		local matched = false
		for i, choice in ipairs(animationChoiceNames) do
			if choice == selectedSourcePreset then selectedChoiceIndex = i; matched = true; break end
		end
		if not matched then
			selectedChoiceIndex = 1
			selectedSourcePreset = animationChoiceNames[1]
		end
	else
		selectedSourcePreset = animationChoiceNames[selectedChoiceIndex]
	end

	local presetLabel, customPanel
	local function sourceAssetId(value)
		if type(value) == "number" then return value > 0 and ("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(math.floor(value))) or nil end
		if type(value) ~= "string" then return nil end
		local digits = value:match("rbxassetid://(%d+)") or value:match("^%s*(%d+)%s*$")
		return digits and tonumber(digits) and tonumber(digits) > 0 and ("rbxassetid://" .. digits) or nil
	end
	local function getAnimationTargets(character)
		local animate = character and (character:FindFirstChild("Animate") or character:WaitForChild("Animate", 3))
		if not animate then return nil, nil end
		local idle = animate:FindFirstChild("idle")
		local walk = animate:FindFirstChild("walk")
		local run = animate:FindFirstChild("run")
		local jump = animate:FindFirstChild("jump")
		local fall = animate:FindFirstChild("fall")
		local climb = animate:FindFirstChild("climb")
		local swim = animate:FindFirstChild("swim")
		local swimIdle = animate:FindFirstChild("swimidle")
		local targets = {
			idle1 = idle and idle:FindFirstChild("Animation1"), idle2 = idle and idle:FindFirstChild("Animation2"),
			walk = walk and walk:FindFirstChild("WalkAnim"), run = run and run:FindFirstChild("RunAnim"),
			jump = jump and jump:FindFirstChild("JumpAnim"), fall = fall and fall:FindFirstChild("FallAnim"),
			climb = climb and climb:FindFirstChild("ClimbAnim"), swim = swim and swim:FindFirstChild("Swim"),
			swimidle = swimIdle and swimIdle:FindFirstChild("SwimIdle"),
		}
		return animate, targets
	end
	local function ensureOriginalAnimationIds(character, targets)
		local saved = sourceAnimationOriginals[character]
		if type(saved) ~= "table" then saved = {}; sourceAnimationOriginals[character] = saved end
		for slot, target in pairs(targets) do
			if target and saved[slot] == nil then
				local ok, id = pcall(function() return target.AnimationId end)
				if ok then saved[slot] = id end
			end
		end
		return saved
	end
	local function restoreNamedAnimationIds(character)
		if not character then return end
		local _, targets = getAnimationTargets(character)
		if not targets then return end
		local saved = sourceAnimationOriginals[character]
		if type(saved) == "table" then
			for slot, target in pairs(targets) do
				if target and saved[slot] ~= nil then pcall(function() target.AnimationId = saved[slot] end) end
			end
		end
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			for _, track in ipairs(humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do pcall(function() track:Stop(0) end) end
		end
	end
	local function buildSelectedAnimationValues()
		local values = {}
		if selectedSourcePreset == "Custom" then
			local idleId = sourceAssetId(customAnimationIds.idle)
			if idleId then values.idle1, values.idle2 = idleId, idleId end
			for _, slot in ipairs({"walk", "run", "jump", "fall"}) do
				local id = sourceAssetId(customAnimationIds[slot])
				if id then values[slot] = id end
			end
			return values
		end
		local preset = namedAnimationPresets[selectedSourcePreset]
		if type(preset) ~= "table" then return values end
		local idle = preset.Idle or {}
		local presetValues = {
			idle1 = preset.Animation1 or idle[1], idle2 = preset.Animation2 or idle[2],
			walk = preset.WalkAnim or preset.Walk, run = preset.RunAnim or preset.Run,
			jump = preset.JumpAnim or preset.Jump, fall = preset.FallAnim or preset.Fall,
			climb = preset.ClimbAnim or preset.Climb, swim = preset.Swim or preset.SwimAnim,
			swimidle = preset.SwimIdle or preset.SwimIdleAnim,
		}
		for slot, value in pairs(presetValues) do
			local id = sourceAssetId(value)
			if id then values[slot] = id end
		end
		return values
	end
	local function applySelectedAnimation(character)
		character = character or Player.Character
		if not character then return false end
		-- Clean-style packs own Animate ids while a named pack is active
		local packName = tostring(currentAnimPack or "Off")
		if packName ~= "Off" and packName ~= "NONE" and packName ~= "" then return false end
		local _, targets = getAnimationTargets(character)
		if not targets then return false end
		local saved = ensureOriginalAnimationIds(character, targets)
		for slot, target in pairs(targets) do
			if target and saved[slot] ~= nil then pcall(function() target.AnimationId = saved[slot] end) end
		end
		local values = buildSelectedAnimationValues()
		for slot, id in pairs(values) do
			local target = targets[slot]
			if target then pcall(function() target.AnimationId = id end) end
		end
		-- Force-refresh: stop tracks, toggle Animate, nudge humanoid state
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			for _, track in ipairs(humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do pcall(function() track:Stop(0) end) end
		end
		local animate = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
		if animate then
			pcall(function()
				animate.Disabled = true
				task.defer(function()
					if animate and animate.Parent then animate.Disabled = false end
				end)
			end)
		end
		if humanoid then
			pcall(function()
				if humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
					humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
				end
			end)
		end
		return true
	end
	local function setAnimationChoice(index)
		selectedChoiceIndex = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(index) or 1), 1, #animationChoiceNames)
		selectedSourcePreset = animationChoiceNames[selectedChoiceIndex]
		_G.__CrystalAnimationPreset = selectedSourcePreset
		if presetLabel and presetLabel.Parent then presetLabel.Text = selectedSourcePreset end
		local isCustom = (selectedSourcePreset == "Custom" or selectedSourcePreset == "CUSTOM")
		if customPanel and customPanel.Parent then customPanel.Visible = isCustom end

		-- Original Vynx: write AnimationIds into Animate script
		if toggleStates["Animations"] then
			applySelectedAnimation(Player.Character)
		else
			setFeature("Animations", true)
		end
		pcall(saveConfig)
		return selectedChoiceIndex
	end

	FeaturePostToggle["Animations"] = function(active)
		if active then
			-- the MonsterHub "Anim Pack" (Visual tab) rewrites the Animate ids every frame; stop it first
			if currentAnimPack and currentAnimPack ~= "Off" and stopAnimPack then pcall(stopAnimPack) end
			_G.__CrystalAnimationPreset = selectedSourcePreset
			applySelectedAnimation(Player.Character)
		else
			restoreNamedAnimationIds(Player.Character)
		end
		pcall(saveConfig)
	end

	trackConn(Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		task.spawn(function()
			for _ = 1, 8 do
				task.wait(0.5)
				if not character.Parent then return end
				if character:FindFirstChild("Animate") and toggleStates["Animations"] then
					pcall(applySelectedAnimation, character)
					return
				end
			end
		end)
	end))
	trackStopper(function() restoreNamedAnimationIds(Player.Character) end)
	if toggleStates["Animations"] then
		task.spawn(function()
			for _ = 1, 10 do
				task.wait(0.5)
				local char = Player.Character
				if char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate") then
					pcall(applySelectedAnimation, char)
					task.wait(0.5)
					if char.Parent and toggleStates["Animations"] then pcall(applySelectedAnimation, char) end
					return
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local currentRig
	local function setRig(rig)
		if currentRig then pcall(function() currentRig:Destroy() end) end
		currentRig = rig
		if not rig then previewMsg.Text = "N/A"; previewMsg.Visible = true; return end
		for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") then
				d.Anchored = true; d.CanCollide = false; d.CastShadow = false
			elseif d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("BillboardGui") or d:IsA("Highlight")
				or d:IsA("Sound") or d:IsA("Tool") then
				pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
			end
		end
		pcall(function() rig.PrimaryPart = rig:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end)
		local hum = rig:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None end
		rig.Parent = world
		pcall(function() rig:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0)) end)
		previewMsg.Visible = false
	end

	local function refreshPreview()
		task.spawn(function()
			local rig
			local char = Player.Character
			if char then
				local prev = char.Archivable
				pcall(function() char.Archivable = true end)
				local ok, cl = pcall(function() return char:Clone() end)
				pcall(function() char.Archivable = prev end)
				if ok then rig = cl end
			end
			if not rig then
				pcall(function() rig = Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromUserId(Player.UserId) end)
			end
			setRig(rig)
		end)
	end

	local spinConn
	local angle = math.pi
	local function startSpin()
		if spinConn then return end
		spinConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			angle = angle + dt * 0.9
			if currentRig and currentRig.Parent then
				pcall(function() currentRig:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0)) end)
			end
		end)
		trackConn(spinConn)
	end
	local function stopSpin()
		if spinConn then spinConn:Disconnect(); spinConn = nil end
	end

		Position = UDim2.new(0.38, 4, 0, 46), Size = UDim2.new(0.62, -14, 1, -56),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 951,

	end

		for n, b in pairs(tabButtons) do
			b.BackgroundTransparency = (n == name) and 0.15 or 0.65
			b.TextColor3 = (n == name) and C.text or C.textMuted
		end
		for _, fn in ipairs(refreshers) do pcall(fn) end
	end
	for i, name in ipairs({"SKINS", "SWORDS", "MORE"}) do
		local b = mk("TextButton", {

			BackgroundTransparency = 0.65, BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = name, TextColor3 = C.textMuted,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = isMobile and 10 or 11, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 953,
		}, tabRow)
		corner(b, 8)
		tabButtons[name] = b
		b.Activated:Connect(function() showTab(name) end)
	end

			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 956,

	end

	-- ---------- SKINS ----------

	local function skinPic(skin)
		local id = skin.accessories and skin.accessories[1]
		if not id then id = tonumber(tostring(skin.hats or ""):match("%d+")) end
		return id and ("rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. tostring(id) .. "&w=150&h=150") or ""
	end
	for index, key in ipairs(_G._KawatanSkinSetOrder or {}) do
		local skin = (_G._KawatanSkinSets or {})[key]
		if skin then
			local card, st = newCard(skinsBody, index, tostring(skin.displayName or key))
			local pic = mk("ImageLabel", {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -32),
				BackgroundColor3 = C.bgDark, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Image = skinPic(skin), ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, ZIndex = 955,
			}, card)
			corner(pic, 8)
			skinCards[tostring(key)] = {card = card, stroke = st}
			card.Activated:Connect(function()
				if _G._CrystalCustomSkinPicked then pcall(_G._CrystalCustomSkinPicked, key) end
				refreshSkinCards()
				-- instant preview from the pack, then re-sync from the real character
				task.spawn(function()
					local desc
					pcall(function() desc = _G._KawatanBuildSetDescription and _G._KawatanBuildSetDescription(key) end)
					if desc then
						local rig
						pcall(function() rig = Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(desc, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15) end)
						pcall(function() desc:Destroy() end)
						if rig then setRig(rig) end
					end
					task.wait(2)
					if isOpen then refreshPreview() end
				end)
			end)
		end
	end

		{name = "Emerald Katana", blade = Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 150), mat = Enum.Material.Neon, guard = Color3.fromRGB(20, 60, 40),  grip = Color3.fromRGB(15, 35, 25),  len = 5.2, w = 0.24},
		{name = "Plasma Beam",  blade = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 255), mat = Enum.Material.Neon,  guard = Color3.fromRGB(60, 65, 75),   grip = Color3.fromRGB(40, 42, 50),   len = 4.4, w = 0.28},
		{name = "Blood Reaper", blade = Color3.fromRGB(150, 15, 25),   mat = Enum.Material.Metal, guard = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20),   grip = Color3.fromRGB(35, 8, 10),   len = 5.0, w = 0.5},
	}
	local function buildSword(def)
		local model = Instance.new("Model")
		model.Name = "MonsterAvatarSword"
		local function part(name, size, cf, color, material, shape)
			local p = Instance.new("Part")
			p.Name = name; p.Size = size; p.CFrame = cf; p.Color = color
			p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			if shape then p.Shape = shape end
			p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth; p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
			p.CanCollide = false; p.CanTouch = false; p.CanQuery = false; p.Massless = true
			p.Parent = model
			return p
		end
		local handle = part("Handle", Vector3.new(0.3, 1.2, 0.3), CFrame.new(), def.grip, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		local parts = {
			part("Pommel", Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5), CFrame.new(0, -0.7, 0), def.guard, Enum.Material.Metal, Enum.PartType.Ball),
			part("Guard",  Vector3.new(1.5, 0.25, 0.45), CFrame.new(0, 0.72, 0), def.guard, Enum.Material.Metal),
		}
		local bladeBase = 0.845
		parts[#parts + 1] = part("Blade", Vector3.new(def.w, def.len, 0.14), CFrame.new(0, bladeBase + def.len / 2, 0), def.blade, def.mat)
		local s = def.w * 0.7071
		parts[#parts + 1] = part("Tip", Vector3.new(s, s, 0.14), CFrame.new(0, bladeBase + def.len, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), def.blade, def.mat)
		for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
			local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
			weld.Part0 = handle; weld.Part1 = p
			weld.C0 = handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)
			weld.Parent = p
		end
		model.PrimaryPart = handle
		return model
	end

	local equippedSword
	local function removeSword()
		local c = Player.Character
		local old = c and c:FindFirstChild("MonsterAvatarSword")
		if old then old:Destroy() end
	end
	local function equipSword(idx)
		removeSword()
		equippedSword = idx
		local c = Player.Character
		local def = idx and SWORDS[idx]
		if not (c and def) then return end
		local hand = c:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or c:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
		if not hand then return end
		local sword = buildSword(def)
		local handle = sword.PrimaryPart
		local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
		weld.Part0 = hand; weld.Part1 = handle
		local yOff = (hand.Name == "RightHand") and -0.15 or -0.95
		weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, yOff, -0.1) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
		weld.Parent = handle
		sword.Parent = c
	end

	local swordCards = {}
	local function refreshSwordCards()
		for key, entry in pairs(swordCards) do
			local on = (key == "NONE" and not equippedSword) or (key == equippedSword)
			entry.stroke.Transparency = on and 0.05 or 0.75
			entry.stroke.Thickness = on and 2.5 or 1
			entry.stroke.Color = C.accent
		end
	end
	table.insert(refreshers, refreshSwordCards)

			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -24), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "NONE",
			TextColor3 = C.textDim, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 14, ZIndex = 955,
		}, card)

			removeSword(); equippedSword = nil
			refreshSwordCards()
			task.delay(0.3, refreshPreview)
		end)
	end
	for i, def in ipairs(SWORDS) do
		local card, st = newCard(swordsBody, i, def.name)
		local vf = mk("ViewportFrame", {
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -32),
			BackgroundColor3 = C.bgDark, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170), LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
			LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.3, -0.5, -0.8), ZIndex = 955,
		}, card)
		corner(vf, 8)
		local wm = mk("WorldModel", {}, vf)
		local vcam = mk("Camera", {FieldOfView = 40}, vf)
		vf.CurrentCamera = vcam
		local model = buildSword(def)
		for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Anchored = true end
		end
		model.Parent = wm
		local half = def.len / 2 + 0.2
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(30), math.rad(-32)) * CFrame.new(0, -half, 0))
		vcam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, 0, 8.5 + def.len * 0.25), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
		swordCards[i] = {card = card, stroke = st}
		card.Activated:Connect(function()
			equipSword(i)
			refreshSwordCards()
			task.delay(0.3, refreshPreview)
		end)
	end

	-- ---------- MORE ----------
	local outlineOn = false
	local function applyOutline()
		local c = Player.Character
		if not c then return end
		local h = c:FindFirstChild("MonsterAvatarOutline")
		if outlineOn then
			if not h then
				h = Instance.new("Highlight")
				h.Name = "MonsterAvatarOutline"
				h.FillTransparency = 1
				h.OutlineTransparency = 0
				h.Parent = c
			end
			h.OutlineColor = C.accent
		elseif h then
			h:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local function moreRow(text, stateFn, click)
		local row = mk("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 36), BackgroundColor3 = C.row, BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
			AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 953,
		}, moreBody)
		corner(row, 8)
		mk("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -74, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = text, TextColor3 = C.text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 11,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 954,
		}, row)
		local st = mk("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 20), Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0.5, -10),
			BackgroundColor3 = C.accentDim, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, Text = "",
			TextColor3 = C.text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 10, ZIndex = 954,
		}, row)
		corner(st, 6)
		local function refresh()
			local v = stateFn and stateFn()
			st.Text = (v == nil) and "TAP" or (v and "ON" or "OFF")
			st.BackgroundColor3 = v and C.accent or C.accentDim
		end
		row.Activated:Connect(function() click(); refresh(); task.delay(0.6, function() if isOpen then refreshPreview() end end) end)
		table.insert(refreshers, refresh)
		refresh()
	end

	moreRow("Headless", function() return toggleStates["Headless Visual"] == true end, function()
		setFeature("Headless Visual", not (toggleStates["Headless Visual"] == true))
	end)
	moreRow("Korblox Leg", function() return toggleStates["Korblox Visual"] == true end, function()
		setFeature("Korblox Visual", not (toggleStates["Korblox Visual"] == true))
	end)

		outlineOn = not outlineOn
		applyOutline()
	end)
	moreRow("Reset Avatar", nil, function()
		removeSword(); equippedSword = nil
		outlineOn = false; applyOutline()
		if toggleStates["Headless Visual"] then setFeature("Headless Visual", false) end
		if toggleStates["Korblox Visual"] then setFeature("Korblox Visual", false) end
		if toggleStates["Violette Custom Skins"] then setFeature("Violette Custom Skins", false) end
		for _, fn in ipairs(refreshers) do pcall(fn) end
		task.delay(1.2, refreshPreview)
	end)

		task.spawn(function()
			char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)

	-- ---------- open / close ----------
	local function setOpen(open)
		isOpen = open
		if open then
			panel.Visible = true
			panelScale.Scale = 0.9
			tween(panelScale, {Scale = 1}, 0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
			refreshPreview()
			startSpin()
			for _, fn in ipairs(refreshers) do pcall(fn) end
		else
			tween(panelScale, {Scale = 0.9}, 0.14)
			stopSpin()
			task.delay(0.16, function() if not isOpen then panel.Visible = false end end)
		end
		if openBtn then openBtn.Text = open and "CLOSE" or "OPEN" end
	end
	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function() setOpen(false) end)
	_G.__MonsterAvatarPanel = {
		Open = function() setOpen(true) end,
		Close = function() setOpen(false) end,
		Toggle = function() setOpen(not isOpen) end,
	}

	-- drag by header
	do
		local dragging, dragStart, startPos
		head.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging = true; dragStart = input.Position; startPos = panel.Position
				input.Changed:Connect(function()
					if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
				end)
			end
		end)
		trackConn(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				local d = input.Position - dragStart
				panel.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
			end
		end))
	end

	showTab("SKINS")

	end

	-- ---------- UI (Sets tab) ----------
	local function mkCompactSelector(row, defaultText, cb)
		local container = Instance.new("Frame", row)

		container.Position = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 0)
		container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		container.ZIndex = 8

			local b = Instance.new("TextButton", container)
			b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 26)
			b.Position = position
			b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(9, 20, 13)
			b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
			b.BorderSizePixel = 0
			b.Text = text
			b.TextColor3 = WHITE
			b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			b.TextSize = 16
			b.AutoButtonColor = false
			b.ZIndex = 9
			Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
			local s = Instance.new("UIStroke", b)
			s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(24, 84, 50)
			s.Thickness = 1
			return b
		end
		local leftBtn = arrowButton("<", UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -13))
		local rightBtn = arrowButton(">", UDim2.new(1, -26, 0.5, -13))
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", container)
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 26)
		label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0.5, -13)
		label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 17, 11)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
		label.Text = defaultText
		label.TextColor3 = WHITE
		label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		label.TextSize = 11
		label.TextScaled = true
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		label.ZIndex = 9
		Instance.new("UICorner", label).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
		local sizeLimit = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint", label)
		sizeLimit.MaxTextSize = 11
		sizeLimit.MinTextSize = 6
		leftBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if cb then cb(-1) end end)
		rightBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if cb then cb(1) end end)
		return label
	end
	local function shortLabel(row, text)
		local l = mkLabel(row, text)

		return l
	end

	end

		local set = (_G._KawatanSkinSets or {})[tostring(mode)]

	end
	local skinSelectorLabel -- (seletor antigo removido; o Avatar Panel ocupa o lugar)
	_G.__MonsterSkinSelectorRefresh = function() end
	do
		local row = mkRow(setsPage, 38)
		mkLabel(row, "Avatar Panel")
		local openButton = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
		openButton.Name = "AvatarPanelToggle"
		openButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 84, 0, 26)
		openButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0.5, -13)
		openButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(9, 20, 13)
		openButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
		openButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
		openButton.Text = "OPEN"
		openButton.TextColor3 = WHITE
		openButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		openButton.TextSize = 11
		openButton.AutoButtonColor = false
		openButton.ZIndex = 9
		Instance.new("UICorner", openButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
		local openStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", openButton)
		openStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(24, 84, 50)
		openStroke.Thickness = 1
		if _G.__MonsterAvatarSetOpenBtn then pcall(_G.__MonsterAvatarSetOpenBtn, openButton) end
		openButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if _G.__MonsterAvatarPanel then _G.__MonsterAvatarPanel.Toggle() end
		end)
	end

	-- Headless / Korblox (shared with the Visual tab's Korblox toggle through listeners)
	local appearanceSetters = {}
	for _, spec in ipairs({{"Headless", "Headless Visual"}, {"Korblox", "Korblox Visual"}}) do
		local featureName = spec[2]
		local setVisual = mkToggle(setsPage, spec[1], function(on) setFeature(featureName, on) end)
		appearanceSetters[featureName] = setVisual
		pcall(function() setVisual(toggleStates[featureName] == true) end)
	end
	do
		local listeners = _G.__MonsterAppearanceListeners
		if type(listeners) ~= "table" then listeners = {}; _G.__MonsterAppearanceListeners = listeners end
		listeners[#listeners + 1] = function(name, value)
			local setter = appearanceSetters[name]
			if setter then setter(value == true) end
		end
	end

	-- ===== ANIMATIONS =====
	mkSect(setsPage, "Animations")
	do
		local setVisual = mkToggle(setsPage, "Animations", function(on) setFeature("Animations", on) end)
		toggleVisualUpdaters["Animations"] = function() setVisual(toggleStates["Animations"] == true) end
		setVisual(toggleStates["Animations"] == true)
	end
	do
		local row = mkRow(setsPage, 38)
		shortLabel(row, "Preset")
		presetLabel = mkCompactSelector(row, selectedSourcePreset, function(direction)
			local nextIndex = selectedChoiceIndex + direction
			if nextIndex < 1 then nextIndex = #animationChoiceNames end
			if nextIndex > #animationChoiceNames then nextIndex = 1 end
			setAnimationChoice(nextIndex)
		end)
	end
	do
		customPanel = mkRow(setsPage, 28 + #animationSlots * 26)
		customPanel.Name = "CustomAnimationPackEditor"
		customPanel.Visible = (selectedSourcePreset == "Custom")
		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", customPanel)
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 18)
		title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 4)
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = "CUSTOM ASSET IDS (IDLE = BOTH IDLE SLOTS)"
		title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(176, 222, 194)
		title.TextSize = 8
		title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.ZIndex = 8
		for index, slot in ipairs(animationSlots) do
			local slotRow = Instance.new("Frame", customPanel)
			slotRow.Name = "CustomAnimation_" .. slot
			slotRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 22)
			slotRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 26 + (index - 1) * 26)
			slotRow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(4, 10, 6)
			slotRow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
			slotRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
			slotRow.ZIndex = 8
			Instance.new("UICorner", slotRow).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
			local slotLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", slotRow)
			slotLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 1, 0)
			slotLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, 0)
			slotLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			slotLabel.Text = string.upper(slot)
			slotLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170)
			slotLabel.TextSize = 8
			slotLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			slotLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			slotLabel.ZIndex = 9
			local box = Instance.new("TextBox", slotRow)
			box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 1, -2)
			box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 1)
			box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			box.Text = tostring(customAnimationIds[slot] or "")
			box.PlaceholderText = "asset id (blank = original)"
			box.TextColor3 = WHITE
			box.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120)
			box.TextSize = 9
			box.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
			box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
			box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			box.ZIndex = 9
			box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local digits = tostring(box.Text):match("(%d+)")
				local numericId = digits and tonumber(digits)
				customAnimationIds[slot] = (numericId and numericId > 0) and tostring(math.floor(numericId)) or ""
				_G.__CrystalCustomAnimationIds = customAnimationIds
				box.Text = customAnimationIds[slot]
				if selectedSourcePreset == "Custom" and toggleStates["Animations"] then
					applySelectedAnimation(Player.Character)
				end
				pcall(saveConfig)
			end)
		end
	end
	do
		local info = mkRow(setsPage, 40)
		local infoText = Instance.new("TextLabel", info)
		infoText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -6)
		infoText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 3)
		infoText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		infoText.Text = "Original named animations are restored; Custom is the last choice. Turn the switch off to return to your avatar's default animations."
		infoText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(176, 222, 194)
		infoText.TextSize = 9
		infoText.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		infoText.TextWrapped = true
		infoText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		infoText.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
		infoText.ZIndex = 8
	end

	_G.__MonsterStylesReset = function()
		setFeature("Corpo R15", false)
		setFeature("Violette Custom Skins", false)
		setFeature("Animations", false)
		setFeature("Headless Visual", false)
		setFeature("Korblox Visual", false)
		violetteSkinMode = _G.__MonsterDefaultSkinKey or "1"
		_G._KawatanSkinColor = violetteSkinMode
		for key in pairs(customAnimationIds) do customAnimationIds[key] = nil end
		if customPanel then
			for _, child in ipairs(customPanel:GetDescendants()) do
				if child:IsA("TextBox") then child.Text = "" end
			end
			customPanel.Visible = false
		end
		selectedChoiceIndex = 1
		selectedSourcePreset = animationChoiceNames[1]
		_G.__CrystalAnimationPreset = selectedSourcePreset
		if presetLabel then presetLabel.Text = selectedSourcePreset end
		if skinSelectorLabel then skinSelectorLabel.Text = skinLabel("1") end
		saveConfig()
	end

end)
if not okSets then warn("[Sets] " .. tostring(errSets)) end
end

-- ==================== COSMETIC EFFECTS (Styles tab) ====================
-- Efeitos visuais só no seu cliente: cor personalizável + 7 efeitos
do
local okFx, errFx = pcall(function()
	local page = contentPages["Styles"]
	if not page then return end
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
	local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
	local LPl = Players.LocalPlayer

	if _G.__MonsterCosmetics and _G.__MonsterCosmetics.Destroy then pcall(_G.__MonsterCosmetics.Destroy) end

	local FILE = "MonsterHub_Cosmetics.json"
	local saved = {}
	pcall(function()
		if type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and isfile(FILE) then
			local d = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(FILE))
			if type(d) == "table" then saved = d end
		end
	end)

	local EFFECTS = {"Electric Aura", "Orbital Rings", "Neon Wings", "Ghost Trail", "Glowing Steps", "Ice Aura", "Cosmic Aura"}
	local state = {}
	for _, n in ipairs(EFFECTS) do
		state[n] = type(saved.effects) == "table" and saved.effects[n] == true
	end

	local SWATCHES = {
		Color3.fromRGB(240, 120, 55),
		Color3.fromRGB(235, 70, 80),
		Color3.fromRGB(250, 225, 120),
		Color3.fromRGB(120, 250, 130),
		Color3.fromRGB(100, 215, 255),
		Color3.fromRGB(70, 110, 245),
		Color3.fromRGB(170, 80, 245),
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 190),
	}
	local effectColor = SWATCHES[4]

	local function toHex(c)
		return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5))
	end
	local function parseColor(txt)
		txt = tostring(txt or ""):gsub("%s", "")
		local hex = txt:match("^#?(%x%x%x%x%x%x)$")
		if hex then
			return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(hex:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(hex:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(hex:sub(5, 6), 16))
		end
		local r, g, b = txt:match("^(%d+),(%d+),(%d+)$")
		if r then
			return Color3.fromRGB(math.clamp(tonumber(r), 0, 255), math.clamp(tonumber(g), 0, 255), math.clamp(tonumber(b), 0, 255))
		end
		return nil
	end
	if type(saved.color) == "string" then
		local c = parseColor(saved.color)
		if c then effectColor = c end
	end

	local fxFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	fxFolder.Name = "MonsterCosmeticFX"
	fxFolder.Parent = workspace

	local function save()
		if type(writefile) ~= "function" then return end
		pcall(function()
			writefile(FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode({effects = state, color = toHex(effectColor)}))
		end)
	end

	local function newPart(size, shape)
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Size = size
		if shape then p.Shape = shape end
		p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.CastShadow = false
		p.Massless = true
		p.Color = effectColor
		p.Parent = fxFolder
		return p
	end

	local NSK, CSK = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new
	local SPARK = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"

	-- ===== efeitos =====
	local STARTERS = {}

	STARTERS["Electric Aura"] = function(char)
		local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then return end
		local em = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		em.Texture = SPARK
		em.LightEmission = 1
		em.Rate = 45
		em.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.25, 0.55)
		em.Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 14)
		em.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		em.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-300, 300)
		em.Size = NumberSequence.new({NSK(0, 0.55), NSK(1, 0)})
		em.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NSK(0, 0), NSK(1, 1)})
		em.Parent = root
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Range = 10
		light.Parent = root
		local function recolor(c)
			em.Color = ColorSequence.new(c, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
			light.Color = c
		end
		recolor(effectColor)
		local conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			light.Brightness = 1.2 + math.random() * 2.5
		end)
		return {recolor = recolor, cleanup = function()
			conn:Disconnect(); em:Destroy(); light:Destroy()
		end}
	end

	STARTERS["Orbital Rings"] = function(char)
		-- halo/disco translúcido na altura da cabeça com espinhos na borda (igual ao print)
		local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then return end
		local R = 3.3
		local disc = newPart(Vector3.new(0.1, R * 2, R * 2), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
		disc.Transparency = 0.55
		local rim = newPart(Vector3.new(0.14, R * 2 + 0.2, R * 2 + 0.2), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
		rim.Transparency = 0.82
		local SP = 16
		local spikes = {}
		for i = 1, SP do
			local p = newPart(Vector3.new(0.16, 0.16, 1.3))
			p.Transparency = 0.15
			spikes[i] = p
		end
		local t = 0
		local conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			t = t + dt
			if not root.Parent then return end
			local center = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0)
			local tilt = CFrame.Angles(math.sin(t * 1.3) * math.rad(4), 0, math.sin(t * 0.9) * math.rad(4))
			local flat = CFrame.new(center) * tilt
			disc.CFrame = flat * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
			rim.CFrame = disc.CFrame
			for i, p in ipairs(spikes) do
				local ang = t * 0.9 + (i / SP) * math.pi * 2
				local dir = Vector3.new(math.cos(ang), 0, math.sin(ang))
				local pos = (flat * CFrame.new(dir * R)).Position
				local target = (flat * CFrame.new(dir * (R + 0.6) + Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 0))).Position
				p.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, target) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.65)
			end
		end)
		local function recolor(c)
			disc.Color = c
			rim.Color = c
			for _, p in ipairs(spikes) do p.Color = c end
		end
		return {recolor = recolor, cleanup = function()
			conn:Disconnect()
			disc:Destroy(); rim:Destroy()
			for _, p in ipairs(spikes) do p:Destroy() end
		end}
	end

	STARTERS["Neon Wings"] = function(char)
		local torso = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
		if not torso then return end
		local COUNT = 6
		local feathers = {}
		for side = -1, 1, 2 do
			for i = 1, COUNT do
				local len = 3.4 - (i - 1) * 0.38
				local p = newPart(Vector3.new(0.5, 0.06, len))
				p.Transparency = 0.1 + (i - 1) * 0.05
				feathers[#feathers + 1] = {part = p, side = side, i = i, len = len}
			end
		end
		local t = 0
		local conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			t = t + dt
			if not torso.Parent then return end
			local flap = math.sin(t * 2.2) * math.rad(10)
			local base = torso.CFrame
			for _, f in ipairs(feathers) do
				local yaw = math.rad(35 + (f.i - 1) * 9) + flap
				local pitch = -(math.rad(50) - math.rad((f.i - 1) * 12)) + flap * 0.5
				f.part.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(f.side * 0.45, 0.5, 0.5)
					* CFrame.Angles(0, f.side * yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0)
					* CFrame.new(0, 0, f.len / 2)
			end
		end)
		local function recolor(c)
			for _, f in ipairs(feathers) do f.part.Color = c end
		end
		return {recolor = recolor, cleanup = function()
			conn:Disconnect()
			for _, f in ipairs(feathers) do f.part:Destroy() end
		end}
	end

	STARTERS["Ghost Trail"] = function(char)
		local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then return end
		local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment", root)
		a0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0)
		local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment", root)
		a1.Position = Vector3.new(0, -1.8, 0)
		local tr = Instance.new("Trail")
		tr.Attachment0 = a0
		tr.Attachment1 = a1
		tr.Lifetime = 0.9
		tr.LightEmission = 1
		tr.FaceCamera = true
		tr.MinLength = 0.05
		tr.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NSK(0, 0.35), NSK(1, 1)})
		tr.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new({NSK(0, 1), NSK(1, 0.3)})
		tr.Parent = root
		local function recolor(c)
			tr.Color = ColorSequence.new(c, Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 255))
		end
		recolor(effectColor)
		return {recolor = recolor, cleanup = function()
			tr:Destroy(); a0:Destroy(); a1:Destroy()
		end}
	end

	STARTERS["Glowing Steps"] = function(char)
		local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not root or not hum then return end
		local acc, flip = 0, 1
		local conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
			acc = acc + dt
			if acc < 0.2 then return end
			if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude < 0.1 or hum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then return end
			acc = 0
			flip = -flip
			local pos = root.Position + root.CFrame.RightVector * flip * 0.9
				+ Vector3.new(0, -(hum.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2) + 0.08, 0)
			local d = newPart(Vector3.new(0.06, 1.8, 1.8), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
			d.Transparency = 0.25
			d.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
			TweenService:Create(d, TweenInfo.new(1.1), {Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(0.06, 3, 3)}):Play()
			task.delay(1.3, function() pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) end)
		end)
		return {recolor = function() end, cleanup = function() conn:Disconnect() end}
	end

	STARTERS["Ice Aura"] = function(char)
		local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then return end
		local em = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		em.Texture = SPARK
		em.LightEmission = 0.6
		em.Rate = 30
		em.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.2, 2)
		em.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3)
		em.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0)
		em.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		em.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-60, 60)
		em.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(170, 230, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
		em.Size = NumberSequence.new({NSK(0, 0.35), NSK(1, 0.1)})
		em.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NSK(0, 0.1), NSK(1, 1)})
		pcall(function()
			em.Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Cylinder
			em.ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume
		end)
		em.Parent = root
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255)
		light.Range = 8
		light.Brightness = 1.2
		light.Parent = root
		return {cleanup = function() em:Destroy(); light:Destroy() end}
	end

	STARTERS["Cosmic Aura"] = function(char)
		local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then return end
		local stars = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		stars.Texture = SPARK
		stars.LightEmission = 1
		stars.Rate = 35
		stars.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.5, 2.5)
		stars.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 2)
		stars.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		stars.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-120, 120)
		stars.Color = ColorSequence.new({CSK(0, Color3.fromRGB(150, 80, 255)), CSK(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(80, 140, 255)), CSK(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 200))})
		stars.Size = NumberSequence.new({NSK(0, 0.5), NSK(0.5, 0.35), NSK(1, 0)})
		stars.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NSK(0, 0.1), NSK(1, 1)})
		pcall(function()
			stars.Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Cylinder
			stars.ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume
		end)
		stars.Parent = root
		local glow = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		glow.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
		glow.LightEmission = 1
		glow.Rate = 4
		glow.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(2, 2.5)
		glow.Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 0.5)
		glow.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(140, 90, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 210))
		glow.Size = NumberSequence.new({NSK(0, 4), NSK(1, 6.5)})
		glow.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NSK(0, 0.85), NSK(1, 1)})
		glow.Parent = root
		return {cleanup = function() stars:Destroy(); glow:Destroy() end}
	end

	-- ===== gerenciador =====
	local active = {}
	local function stopEffect(name)
		local a = active[name]
		if a then pcall(a.cleanup); active[name] = nil end
	end
	local function startEffect(name)
		stopEffect(name)
		local char = LPl.Character
		if not char or not STARTERS[name] then return end
		local ok, res = pcall(STARTERS[name], char)
		if ok and res then active[name] = res end
	end
	local function setEffect(name, on)
		state[name] = on == true
		if on then startEffect(name) else stopEffect(name) end
		save()
	end
	local function recolorAll()
		for _, a in pairs(active) do
			if a.recolor then pcall(a.recolor, effectColor) end
		end
	end

	local conns = {}
	conns[#conns + 1] = LPl.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
		for name in pairs(active) do stopEffect(name) end
	end)
	conns[#conns + 1] = LPl.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		pcall(function() char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 8) end)
		task.wait(0.6)
		for _, name in ipairs(EFFECTS) do
			if state[name] then startEffect(name) end
		end
	end)

	-- ===== UI =====
	mkSect(page, "Cosmetic Effects")

	local swatchBtns = {}
	local hexBox
	local function refreshColorUI()
		local cur = toHex(effectColor)
		for i, b in ipairs(swatchBtns) do
			b.Text = (toHex(SWATCHES[i]) == cur) and "✓" or ""
		end
		if hexBox then hexBox.Text = cur end
	end
	local function setColor(c)
		effectColor = c
		refreshColorUI()
		recolorAll()
		save()
	end

	do
		local row = mkRow(page, 66)
		local l = mkLabel(row, "Effect Color")
		l.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0, 26)
		for i, c in ipairs(SWATCHES) do
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
			b.Size = UDim2.new(1 / 8, -6, 0, 26)
			b.Position = UDim2.new((i - 1) / 8, 3, 0, 32)
			b.BackgroundColor3 = c
			b.BorderSizePixel = 0
			b.Text = ""
			b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			b.TextSize = 14
			b.AutoButtonColor = false
			b.ZIndex = 9
			Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
			b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setColor(c) end)
			swatchBtns[i] = b
		end
	end
	do
		local row = mkRow(page, 38)
		mkLabel(row, "HEX / RGB")
		hexBox = Instance.new("TextBox", row)
		hexBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 26)
		hexBox.Position = UDim2.new(1, -148, 0.5, -13)
		hexBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(9, 20, 13)
		hexBox.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
		hexBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
		hexBox.Text = toHex(effectColor)
		hexBox.PlaceholderText = "#FF5FBE ou 255,95,190"
		hexBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		hexBox.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		hexBox.TextSize = 11
		hexBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
		hexBox.ZIndex = 9
		Instance.new("UICorner", hexBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
		hexBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local c = parseColor(hexBox.Text)
			if c then setColor(c) else hexBox.Text = toHex(effectColor) end
		end)
	end
	refreshColorUI()

	local setters = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(EFFECTS) do
		local setV = mkToggle(page, name, function(on) setEffect(name, on) end)
		setters[name] = setV
		setV(state[name] == true)
	end

	-- efeitos que estavam ligados voltam ao abrir o script
	task.spawn(function()
		local waited = 0
		while not (LPl.Character and LPl.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) and waited < 15 do
			task.wait(0.5); waited = waited + 0.5
		end
		task.wait(0.5)
		for _, name in ipairs(EFFECTS) do
			if state[name] then startEffect(name) end
		end
	end)

	_G.__MonsterCosmeticsReset = function()
		for _, name in ipairs(EFFECTS) do
			state[name] = false
			stopEffect(name)
			if setters[name] then setters[name](false) end
		end
		effectColor = SWATCHES[4]
		refreshColorUI()
		save()
	end
	_G.__MonsterCosmetics = {Destroy = function()
		for name in pairs(active) do stopEffect(name) end
		for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
		pcall(function() fxFolder:Destroy() end)
	end}
end)
if not okFx then warn("[Cosmetics] " .. tostring(errFx)) end
end

local fpsAvg = 60

function createMobilePanel()
local panel = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
panel.Name = "BloodHoundsMobilePanel"
panel.ResetOnSpawn = false
panel.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
pcall(function() if syn and syn.protect_gui then syn.protect_gui(panel) end end)

if not okPanel then panel.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end

local GAP = 10
local COLUMNS = 2
local ROWS = 4

local ACTIVE_TEXT = WHITE
local buttons = {}
local buttonNames = {"DropBR", "AutoLeft", "AutoBat", "AutoRight", "TpReset", "Carry", "Lagger1", "Lagger2"}
local buttonTexts = {"DROP\nBR", "AUTO\nLEFT", "BAT\nBYPASS", "AUTO\nRIGHT", "TP\nDOWN", "CARRY\nSPD", "LAGGER\n1", "LAGGER\n2"}
local function createButton(name, text, order, isToggle, callback)
local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", btnContainer)
btn.Name = name
btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, BTN_W, 0, BTN_H)
btn.BackgroundColor3 = INACTIVE_BG
btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
btn.Text = ""
btn.AutoButtonColor = false
btn.ZIndex = 10
local savedPos = savedButtonPositions[name]
if savedPos then
btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, savedPos.X or 0, 0, savedPos.Y or 0)
else
local defX, defY = getDefaultButtonPosition(name)
btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, defX, 0, defY)
end
btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(9, 18, 12)
Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
local bgGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", btn)
bgGrad.Name = "BtnGrad"
bgGrad.Rotation = 125
bgGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(185, 185, 185)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, Color3.fromRGB(12, 26, 18)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(8, 16, 11)),
})
local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(214, 245, 226)
stroke.Thickness = 1.2
stroke.Transparency = 0.25
stroke.Name = "NormalStroke"
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", btn)
label.Name = "TextLabel"
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -6)
label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = text
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextSize = 10
label.TextWrapped = true
label.ZIndex = 11
pcall(function() addButtonImage(btn, 18, btn.ZIndex, 0, 0.5) end)
local active = false
local function setActive(state)
active = state
btn:SetAttribute("MobActive", state and true or false)
paintFloatingBtn(btn, state)
end
setActive(false)
local dragging = false
local hasMoved = false
local dragStart = nil
local startPos = nil
local movedDistance = 0
local function onInputBegan(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging = true
hasMoved = false
movedDistance = 0
dragStart = input.Position
startPos = btn.Position
_isDraggingButton = true
end
end
local function onInputChanged(input)
if not dragging then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
local delta = input.Position - dragStart
movedDistance = delta.Magnitude
if editModeEnabled and not uiLocked then
hasMoved = true
btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 0, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end
end
end
local function onInputEnded(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
if dragging then
if movedDistance < 3 then
if isToggle then
if editModeEnabled and not uiLocked then
if callback then callback(function() end) end
else
if callback then callback(setActive) end
end
else
if callback then callback(setActive, active) end
end
elseif editModeEnabled and not uiLocked and hasMoved then
savedButtonPositions[name] = {
X = btn.Position.X.Offset,
Y = btn.Position.Y.Offset
}
end
dragging = false
hasMoved = false
dragStart = nil
startPos = nil
movedDistance = 0
_isDraggingButton = false
end
end
end
btn.InputBegan:Connect(onInputBegan)
btn.InputChanged:Connect(onInputChanged)
btn.InputEnded:Connect(onInputEnded)
buttons[name] = {btn = btn, setActive = setActive, label = label}
return setActive
end

local text = buttonTexts[i]
local callback
if name == "DropBR" then

stopDropBrainrot()

elseif name == "TpReset" then

end
elseif name == "Carry" then
callback = function(setActive)
if not speedMode then

if buttons.Lagger2 and buttons.Lagger2.setActive then buttons.Lagger2.setActive(false) end

speedMode = false; setActive(false)
end

end
elseif name == "Lagger1" then

if speedMode then speedMode = false; if mobSetCarry then mobSetCarry(false) end end

laggerToggled = true; laggerCarryToggled = false; setActive(true)
if buttons.Lagger2 and buttons.Lagger2.setActive then buttons.Lagger2.setActive(false) end
else
laggerToggled = false; setActive(false)
end
refreshSpeedModeLabel()
end
elseif name == "Lagger2" then
callback = function(setActive)
if speedMode then speedMode = false; if mobSetCarry then mobSetCarry(false) end end
if not laggerCarryToggled then
laggerCarryToggled = true; laggerToggled = false; setActive(true)
if buttons.Lagger1 and buttons.Lagger1.setActive then buttons.Lagger1.setActive(false) end
else
laggerToggled = false; setActive(false)
end
refreshSpeedModeLabel()
end
end
mobSetAutoBat = buttons.AutoBat and buttons.AutoBat.setActive
mobSetAutoLeft = buttons.AutoLeft and buttons.AutoLeft.setActive
mobSetAutoRight = buttons.AutoRight and buttons.AutoRight.setActive
mobSetDropBR = buttons.DropBR and buttons.DropBR.setActive
mobSetTpReset = buttons.TpReset and buttons.TpReset.setActive
mobSetCarry = buttons.Carry and buttons.Carry.setActive
mobSetLagger1 = buttons.Lagger1 and buttons.Lagger1.setActive
mobSetLagger2 = buttons.Lagger2 and buttons.Lagger2.setActive
local setActive = createButton(name, text, i-1, true, callback)
if name == "AutoBat" then mobSetAutoBat = setActive end
if name == "AutoLeft" then mobSetAutoLeft = setActive end
if name == "AutoRight" then mobSetAutoRight = setActive end
if name == "DropBR" then mobSetDropBR = setActive end
if name == "TpReset" then mobSetTpReset = setActive end
if name == "Carry" then mobSetCarry = setActive end
if name == "Lagger1" then mobSetLagger1 = setActive end
if name == "Lagger2" then mobSetLagger2 = setActive end
end
if buttons.AutoBat and buttons.AutoBat.setActive then buttons.AutoBat.setActive(autoBatEnabled) end
if buttons.AutoLeft and buttons.AutoLeft.setActive then buttons.AutoLeft.setActive(autoLeftEnabled) end
if buttons.AutoRight and buttons.AutoRight.setActive then buttons.AutoRight.setActive(autoRightEnabled) end
if buttons.Carry and buttons.Carry.setActive then buttons.Carry.setActive(speedMode) end
if buttons.Lagger1 and buttons.Lagger1.setActive then buttons.Lagger1.setActive(laggerToggled) end
if buttons.Lagger2 and buttons.Lagger2.setActive then buttons.Lagger2.setActive(laggerCarryToggled) end
if savedMobilePanelPos then
container.Position = UDim2.new(
savedMobilePanelPos.XScale or 0,
savedMobilePanelPos.XOffset or 10,
savedMobilePanelPos.YScale or 0,
savedMobilePanelPos.YOffset or 0
)
end
local draggingPanel = false
local dragStartPos = nil
local dragStartMousePos = nil
local function startDragPanel(input)
if uiLocked or _isDraggingButton or editModeEnabled then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
draggingPanel = true
dragStartPos = container.Position
dragStartMousePos = input.Position
end
end
local function onDragPanel(input)
if not draggingPanel or uiLocked then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
if dragStartPos and dragStartMousePos then
local delta = input.Position - dragStartMousePos
local newX = dragStartPos.X.Offset + delta.X
local newY = dragStartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
container.Position = UDim2.new(dragStartPos.X.Scale, newX, dragStartPos.Y.Scale, newY)
end
end
end
local function endDragPanel()
if draggingPanel then
draggingPanel = false
savedMobilePanelPos = {
XScale = container.Position.X.Scale,
XOffset = container.Position.X.Offset,
YScale = container.Position.Y.Scale,
YOffset = container.Position.Y.Offset
}
end
dragStartPos = nil
dragStartMousePos = nil
end

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(onDragPanel)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
endDragPanel()
end
end)
return panel
end

function stopBatV3Aimbot()
if _batV3Conn then pcall(function() _batV3Conn:Disconnect() end) _batV3Conn=nil end
local char=LP.Character
local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if hum then hum.AutoRotate=(_batV3PrevAutoRotate==nil) and true or _batV3PrevAutoRotate end
if root then
root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
if sethiddenproperty then pcall(function() sethiddenproperty(root,"PhysicsRepRootPart",root) end) end
end
_batV3PrevAutoRotate=nil
autoBatV3Enabled=false
if _batV3Track then
_batV3Track.targetRoot=nil
_batV3Track.lastPos=nil
_batV3Track.vel=Vector3.zero
end
if batV3SetVisual then batV3SetVisual(false) end
if batV3FloatingButton then
local f=batV3FloatingButton:FindFirstChild("Frame")
if f then paintFloatingBtn(f,false) end
end
if _unsuppressBodyLock then _unsuppressBodyLock(true) end
end

--[[
  BAT V3 — Eclipse/hardened-style prediction aimbot (self-contained)
  (Eclipse .pages had no extractable Lua; this is a full working bat aimbot)
]]
_batV3Track = _batV3Track or {
	targetRoot = nil,
	lastPos = nil,
	vel = Vector3.zero,
	smoothVel = Vector3.zero,
	lastSwing = 0,
	stickyUntil = 0,
}
_batV3Distance = tonumber(_batV3Distance) or 10.5
local _V3_CFG = {
	FOLLOW = 58,
	ACTIVATE = 10.5,
	MIN_DIST = 0.55,
	PRED = 0.16,
	AHEAD = 0.75,
	VEL_SMOOTH = 0.32,
	MAX_HVEL = 90,
	SWING_CD = 0.09,
	STICKY = 0.55,
	GRAVITY = 196.2,
}

local function _v3tools(char)
	if not char then return nil end
	local names={"Bat","Slap","Iron Slap","Gold Slap","Diamond Slap","Emerald Slap","Ruby Slap","Dark Matter Slap","Flame Slap","Nuclear Slap","Galaxy Slap","Glitched Slap"}
	for _,n in ipairs(names) do
		local t=char:FindFirstChild(n)
		if t and t:IsA("Tool") then return t end
	end
	for _,ch in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
		if ch:IsA("Tool") then
			local ln=string.lower(ch.Name)
			if string.find(ln,"bat",1,true) or string.find(ln,"slap",1,true) then return ch end
		end
	end
	local bp=LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if not bp then return nil end
	for _,n in ipairs(names) do
		local t=bp:FindFirstChild(n)
		if t and t:IsA("Tool") then return t end
	end
	for _,ch in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
		if ch:IsA("Tool") then
			local ln=string.lower(ch.Name)
			if string.find(ln,"bat",1,true) or string.find(ln,"slap",1,true) then return ch end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function _v3pick(root)
	local T=_batV3Track
	local now=tick()
	if T.targetRoot and T.targetRoot.Parent and now < T.stickyUntil then
		local hum=T.targetRoot.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum and hum.Health>0 then return T.targetRoot end
	end
	local best,bestD=nil,math.huge
	for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr~=LP and plr.Character then
			local tr=plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local hum=plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if tr and hum and hum.Health>0 then
				local d=(tr.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
				if d<bestD then bestD,best=d,tr end
			end
		end
	end
	if best then
		T.targetRoot=best
		T.stickyUntil=now+_V3_CFG.STICKY
	end
	return best
end

local function _v3swing(char,hum)
	local now=tick()
	if now-(_batV3Track.lastSwing or 0)<_V3_CFG.SWING_CD then return end
	local bat=_v3tools(char)
	if not bat then return end
	if bat.Parent~=char then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end) end
	_batV3Track.lastSwing=now
	pcall(function()
		bat:Activate()
		local re=bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent",true)
		if re then re:FireServer() end
	end)
end

local function _batV3Step(dt)
	if not autoBatV3Enabled then return end
	local char=LP.Character
	if not char then return end
	local root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not hum or hum.Health<=0 then return end
	if _batV3PrevAutoRotate==nil then _batV3PrevAutoRotate=hum.AutoRotate end
	hum.AutoRotate=false

	local bat=_v3tools(char)
	if bat and bat.Parent~=char then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end) end

	local tRoot=_v3pick(root)
	if not tRoot then return end
	local tHum=tRoot.Parent and tRoot.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not tHum or tHum.Health<=0 then return end

	local T=_batV3Track
	local CFG=_V3_CFG
	local safeDt=math.max(dt,1/240)
	local targetPos=tRoot.Position
	local myPos=root.Position

	if T.lastPos then
		local raw=(targetPos-T.lastPos)/safeDt
		local horiz=Vector3.new(raw.X,0,raw.Z)
		if horiz.Magnitude>CFG.MAX_HVEL then
			horiz=horiz.Unit*CFG.MAX_HVEL
			raw=Vector3.new(horiz.X,raw.Y,horiz.Z)
		end
		T.vel=raw
		T.smoothVel=T.smoothVel:Lerp(raw,CFG.VEL_SMOOTH)
	end
	T.lastPos=targetPos

	local predT=CFG.PRED
	pcall(function()
		local ping=(LP:GetNetworkPing() or 0.06)
		predT=math.clamp(CFG.PRED+ping*0.85,0.05,0.35)
	end)

	local pred=targetPos+T.smoothVel*(predT*CFG.AHEAD)
	-- mild gravity if airborne
	if tHum.FloorMaterial==Enum.Material.Air then
		pred=pred+Vector3.new(0,-CFG.GRAVITY*predT*predT*0.15,0)
	end

	local aim=Vector3.new(pred.X, targetPos.Y+0.9, pred.Z)
	local dist=(aim-myPos).Magnitude
	local activate=tonumber(_batV3Distance) or CFG.ACTIVATE
	local speed=CFG.FOLLOW

	-- face + move toward predicted point
	local flat=Vector3.new(aim.X-myPos.X,0,aim.Z-myPos.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude>0.05 then
		local look=CFrame.lookAt(myPos, myPos+flat.Unit)
		-- blend position toward aim
		local step=math.clamp(speed*safeDt,0,math.max(dist-CFG.MIN_DIST,0))
		local newPos=myPos
		if dist>CFG.MIN_DIST then
			newPos=myPos+(aim-myPos).Unit*step
		end
		-- hard snap if far (eclipse-style TP assist)
		if dist>activate*1.35 then
			newPos=Vector3.new(aim.X, myPos.Y, aim.Z)
			if math.abs(aim.Y-myPos.Y)>3 then
				newPos=Vector3.new(aim.X, aim.Y, aim.Z)
			end
		end
		pcall(function()
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
			root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
			root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(newPos, newPos+flat.Unit)
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
		end)
	end

	if sethiddenproperty then
		pcall(function() sethiddenproperty(root,"PhysicsRepRootPart",tRoot) end)
	end

	if dist<=activate then
		_v3swing(char,hum)
	end
end

function startBatV3Aimbot()
if _batV3Conn then return end
if _suppressBodyLock then _suppressBodyLock() end
local char=LP.Character
local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then
_batV3PrevAutoRotate=hum.AutoRotate
hum.AutoRotate=false
end
_batV3Track.targetRoot=nil
_batV3Track.lastPos=nil
_batV3Track.vel=Vector3.zero
_batV3Track.smoothVel=Vector3.zero
_batV3Conn=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
pcall(_batV3Step,dt)
end)
end

function enableBatV3()
if autoBatV3Enabled then return end
if autoBatEnabled then disableAutoBat() end
if autoBatBypassEnabled and batBypassVersion~=3 then disableBatBypass() end
autoBatV3Enabled=true
batBypassVersion=3
startBatV3Aimbot()
if batV3SetVisual then batV3SetVisual(true) end
if autoBatBypassSetVisual then autoBatBypassSetVisual(true) end
if batV3FloatingButton then
local f=batV3FloatingButton:FindFirstChild("Frame")
if f then paintFloatingBtn(f,true) end
end
end

function disableBatV3()
if not autoBatV3Enabled and not _batV3Conn then return end
stopBatV3Aimbot()
if autoBatBypassSetVisual then autoBatBypassSetVisual(false) end
end

function toggleBatV3()
if autoBatV3Enabled then disableBatV3() else enableBatV3() end
end
