label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = "BAT\nV3"
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
label.TextSize = 11
label.TextWrapped = true
label.ZIndex = 21
addButtonImage(btnFrame, 18, btnFrame.ZIndex, 0, 0.5)
local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale", btnFrame)
uiScale.Scale = floatingButtonScale
table.insert(_floatingUIScales, uiScale)
local function setActive(state) paintFloatingBtn(btnFrame, state) end
local dragging, hasMoved, dragStart, startPos = false, false, nil, nil
btnFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging = true; hasMoved = false; dragStart = inp.Position; startPos = btnFrame.Position
end
end)
btnFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
if not dragging then return end
if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
local delta = inp.Position - dragStart
if delta.Magnitude > 5 then hasMoved = true end
if hasMoved and not uiLocked then
btnFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end
end
end)
btnFrame.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
if dragging then
if not hasMoved then setActive(not autoBatV3Enabled); toggleBatV3()
elseif not uiLocked and hasMoved then
batV3FloatingPos = {XScale=btnFrame.Position.X.Scale, XOffset=btnFrame.Position.X.Offset, YScale=btnFrame.Position.Y.Scale, YOffset=btnFrame.Position.Y.Offset}
end
dragging = false; hasMoved = false
end
end
end)
batV3FloatingButton = panel
return panel
end
function createInstaResetFloatingButton()
local panel = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
panel.Name = "InstaResetButton"
panel.ResetOnSpawn = false
panel.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
panel.DisplayOrder = 23
pcall(function() if syn and syn.protect_gui then syn.protect_gui(panel) end end)
local okPanel = pcall(function() panel.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
if not okPanel then panel.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end
local btnFrame = Instance.new("Frame", panel)
btnFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 64, 0, 64)
btnFrame.Name = "Frame"
if instaResetFloatingPos then
btnFrame.Position = UDim2.new(instaResetFloatingPos.XScale or 0.5,
instaResetFloatingPos.XOffset or 90,
instaResetFloatingPos.YScale or 0,
instaResetFloatingPos.YOffset or 10)
else
btnFrame.Position = adaptTpBatDefaultPos()
end
btnFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
btnFrame.BorderSizePixel  = 0
btnFrame.ZIndex           = 20
Instance.new("UICorner", btnFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)
local bgGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", btnFrame)
bgGrad.Name = "BtnGrad"
bgGrad.Rotation = 90
bgGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(185, 185, 185)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, Color3.fromRGB(12, 26, 18)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(8, 16, 11)),
})
local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btnFrame)
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(214, 245, 226)
stroke.Thickness = 1
stroke.Transparency = 0.55
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", btnFrame)
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = "INSTA\nRESET"
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
label.TextSize = 11
label.TextWrapped = true
label.ZIndex = 21
addButtonImage(btnFrame, 18, btnFrame.ZIndex, 0, 0.5)
pcall(function() paintFloatingBtn(btnFrame, false) end)
local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale", btnFrame)
uiScale.Scale = floatingButtonScale
table.insert(_floatingUIScales, uiScale)
local dragging, hasMoved, dragStart, startPos, activeInput
local RESET_TAP_THRESHOLD = 12
local function pointInside(pos)
local ap = btnFrame.AbsolutePosition
local as = btnFrame.AbsoluteSize
return pos.X >= ap.X and pos.X <= ap.X + as.X
and pos.Y >= ap.Y and pos.Y <= ap.Y + as.Y
end
local function setActive(state)
if state then
TS:Create(btnFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.05), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)}):Play()
TS:Create(label,    TweenInfo.new(0.05), {TextColor3       = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)}):Play()
else
paintFloatingBtn(btnFrame, false)
end
end
btnFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
if activeInput then return end
activeInput = inp
dragging    = true
hasMoved    = false
dragStart   = inp.Position
startPos    = btnFrame.Position
end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
if not dragging or not activeInput then return end
local isTouchMove = activeInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and inp == activeInput
local isMouseMove = activeInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
if not isTouchMove and not isMouseMove then return end
local delta = inp.Position - dragStart
if delta.Magnitude > RESET_TAP_THRESHOLD then hasMoved = true end
if hasMoved and not uiLocked then
btnFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
)
end
end)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
if inp ~= activeInput then return end
if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
and inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
if dragging then
local delta = inp.Position - dragStart
local validTap = not hasMoved
and delta.Magnitude <= RESET_TAP_THRESHOLD
and pointInside(inp.Position)
if validTap then
print("[IR] tap → instaReset()")
setActive(true)
if _G.InstaReset and _G.InstaReset.Trigger then
_G.InstaReset.Trigger()
end
task.delay(0.2, function() setActive(false) end)
elseif not uiLocked and hasMoved then
instaResetFloatingPos = {
XScale  = btnFrame.Position.X.Scale,
XOffset = btnFrame.Position.X.Offset,
YScale  = btnFrame.Position.Y.Scale,
YOffset = btnFrame.Position.Y.Offset,
}
pcall(saveAllSettings)
end
dragging    = false
hasMoved    = false
activeInput = nil
end
end)
instaResetFloatingButton = panel
return panel
end
batCounterBypassEnabled = false
batCounterBypassDebounce = false
batCounterBypassConn = nil
batCounterBypassHitCooldown = false
BAT_COUNTER_BYPASS_SWING_CD = 0.08
setBatCounterBypassVisual = nil
local _batCounterBypassOriginalTpState = false
local _batCounterBypassSuppressCount = 0
local _lastBatCounterBypassTime = 0
local _batCounterBypassCooldown = 0.01
local function isPlayerRagdolled(player)
if not player or not player.Character then return false end
local hum = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not hum then return false end
local state = hum:GetState()
return state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or
state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or
state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
end
local function hasAnimalEquipped(player)
if not player or not player.Character then return false end
for _, child in ipairs(player.Character:GetChildren()) do
if child:IsA("Tool") then
if child:FindFirstChild("Handle") or child.Name:find("Animal") or child.Name:find("Pet") then
return true
end
end
end
return false
end
local function getAttackingPlayerWithAnimal()
local myChar = LP.Character
if not myChar then return nil end
local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not myRoot then return nil end
local closest, minDist = nil, _huge
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
if not hasAnimalEquipped(plr) then continue end
local tRoot = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if tRoot and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
local dist = (tRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
if dist < 12 and dist < minDist then
minDist = dist
closest = plr
end
end
end
end
return closest
end
local function getBatBypassCounter()
local char = LP.Character
if not char then return nil end
for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
if child:IsA("Tool") then
local name = child.Name:lower()
if name:find("bat") or name:find("slap") or name:find("sword") or name:find("knife") then
return child
end
end
end
local bp = LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
if bp then
for _, child in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
if child:IsA("Tool") then
local name = child.Name:lower()
if name:find("bat") or name:find("slap") or name:find("sword") or name:find("knife") then
child.Parent = char
return child
end
end
end
end
if bp then
for _, child in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
if child:IsA("Tool") then
child.Parent = char
return child
end
end
end
return nil
end
local function tryHitBatCounterBypass()
if batCounterBypassHitCooldown then return end
batCounterBypassHitCooldown = true
pcall(function()
local bat = getBatBypassCounter()
if bat then
bat:Activate()
local ev = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
if ev then ev:FireServer() end
end
end)
task.delay(BAT_COUNTER_BYPASS_SWING_CD, function()
batCounterBypassHitCooldown = false
end)
end
local function executeBatCounterBypass()
local now = _tick()
if now - _lastBatCounterBypassTime < _batCounterBypassCooldown then return end
if batCounterBypassDebounce then return end
batCounterBypassDebounce = true
_lastBatCounterBypassTime = now
local attacker = getAttackingPlayerWithAnimal()
if not attacker then
batCounterBypassDebounce = false
return
end
if isPlayerRagdolled(attacker) then
batCounterBypassDebounce = false
return
end
if not hasAnimalEquipped(attacker) then
batCounterBypassDebounce = false
return
end
local function doCounterHit()
local char = LP.Character
if not char then return end
local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not hrp then return end
local attChar = attacker.Character
if not attChar then return end
local attRoot = attChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not attRoot then return end
if not hasAnimalEquipped(attacker) then
batCounterBypassDebounce = false
return
end
if sethiddenproperty then
sethiddenproperty(hrp, "PhysicsRepRootPart", attRoot)
end
local targetPos = attRoot.Position + _V3new(0, 0.9, 0)
if (hrp.Position - targetPos).Magnitude > 8 then
hrp.CFrame = _CFnew(targetPos)
end
tryHitBatCounterBypass()
task.delay(0.05, function() tryHitBatCounterBypass() end)
task.delay(0.1, function() tryHitBatCounterBypass() end)
end
doCounterHit()
task.delay(0.2, function()
batCounterBypassDebounce = false
end)
end
function stopBatCounterBypass()
if batCounterBypassConn then
batCounterBypassConn:Disconnect()
batCounterBypassConn = nil
end
batCounterBypassDebounce = false
batCounterBypassHitCooldown = false
end
function startBatCounterBypass()
if batCounterBypassConn then return end
batCounterBypassConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
if not batCounterBypassEnabled then return end
if batCounterBypassDebounce then return end
local character = LP.Character
if not character then return end
local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
local state = humanoid:GetState()
local isBeingAttacked = state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or
state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or
state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or
state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp or
state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Stunned
if isBeingAttacked then
local attacker = getAttackingPlayerWithAnimal()
if attacker then
if not isPlayerRagdolled(attacker) then
if hasAnimalEquipped(attacker) then
executeBatCounterBypass()
end
end
end
end
end)
end
function toggleBatCounterBypass()
batCounterBypassEnabled = not batCounterBypassEnabled
if batCounterBypassEnabled then
startBatCounterBypass()
else
stopBatCounterBypass()
end
return batCounterBypassEnabled
end

-- ==================== TP BAT (botão flutuante) ====================
task.spawn(function()
local okTpBat, errTpBat = pcall(function()
local tpBatEnabled = false
local tpBatConn = nil
local tpBatLastSwing = 0
local TPBAT_SWING_DELAY = 0.05
local TPBAT_HEIGHT = 0.9
local TPBAT_SNAP_DIST = 8
local tpBatBtnFrame = nil
local function setHidden(part, prop, val)
pcall(function()
local f = sethiddenproperty or set_hidden_property or set_hidden_prop
if f then f(part, prop, val) end
end)
end
local function nearestTarget(myRoot)
local best, bestDist = nil, _huge
for _, plr in ipairs(_GetPlayersCached()) do
if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
local r = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local h = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if r and h and h.Health > 0 then
local d = (r.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
if d < bestDist then bestDist = d; best = r end
end
end
end
return best
end
local function isBat(t)
if not t or not t:IsA("Tool") then return false end
local n = t.Name:lower()
return n:find("bat", 1, true) ~= nil or n:find("slap", 1, true) ~= nil
end
local function getBat(char, hum)
for _, c in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do if isBat(c) then return c end end
local bp = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
if bp then
for _, c in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
if isBat(c) then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(c) end); return c end
end
end
return char:FindFirstChild("Bat")
end
local function stopTpBat()
tpBatEnabled = false
if tpBatConn then tpBatConn:Disconnect(); tpBatConn = nil end
local char = LP.Character
local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hrp then
setHidden(hrp, "PhysicsRepRootPart", nil)
hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = _V3zero
hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = _V3zero
end
if hum then pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = true; hum.PlatformStand = false; hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end) end
if tpBatBtnFrame then paintFloatingBtn(tpBatBtnFrame, false) end
end
local function startTpBat()
tpBatEnabled = true
if tpBatConn then tpBatConn:Disconnect() end
tpBatConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
if not tpBatEnabled then return end
local char = LP.Character
local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
local target = nearestTarget(hrp)
if not target then return end
pcall(function() if hrp.SetNetworkOwner then hrp:SetNetworkOwner(LP) end end)
setHidden(hrp, "PhysicsRepRootPart", target)
hum.AutoRotate = false
local dest = target.Position + _V3new(0, TPBAT_HEIGHT, 0)
if (hrp.Position - dest).Magnitude > TPBAT_SNAP_DIST then
hrp.CFrame = _CFnew(dest)
end
local now = _tick()
if now - tpBatLastSwing >= TPBAT_SWING_DELAY then
tpBatLastSwing = now
pcall(function()
local bat = getBat(char, hum)
if not bat then return end
if bat.Parent ~= char then hum:EquipTool(bat) end
if bat.Parent == char then
bat:Activate()
local re = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
if re then re:FireServer() end
end
end)
end
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if cam then cam.CFrame = _CFnew(cam.CFrame.Position, target.Position) end
end)
if tpBatBtnFrame then paintFloatingBtn(tpBatBtnFrame, true) end
end
local function toggleTpBat()
if tpBatEnabled then stopTpBat() else startTpBat() end
end
local function createTpBatButton()
local panel = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
panel.Name = "TpBatButton"
panel.ResetOnSpawn = false
panel.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
panel.DisplayOrder = 21
pcall(function() if syn and syn.protect_gui then syn.protect_gui(panel) end end)
local okPanel = pcall(function() panel.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
if not okPanel then panel.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end
local f = Instance.new("Frame", panel)
f.Name = "Frame"
f.Size = UDim2.new(0, 64, 0, 64)
f.Position = adaptTpBatDefaultPos()
if savedTpBatPos then
pcall(function()
f.Position = UDim2.new(savedTpBatPos.XS or 0, savedTpBatPos.XO or 0, savedTpBatPos.YS or 0, savedTpBatPos.YO or 0)
end)
end
_tpBatFrame = f
f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
f.BorderSizePixel = 0
f.ZIndex = 20
Instance.new("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)
local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient", f)
grad.Name = "BtnGrad"
grad.Rotation = 90
grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(70, 210, 130)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, Color3.fromRGB(24, 110, 64)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(8, 44, 26)),
})
local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", f)
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(214, 245, 226)
stroke.Thickness = 1
stroke.Transparency = 0.55
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", f)
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = "TP BAT"
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
label.TextSize = 11
label.TextWrapped = true
label.ZIndex = 21
local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale", f)
uiScale.Scale = floatingButtonScale
table.insert(_floatingUIScales, uiScale)
tpBatBtnFrame = f
paintFloatingBtn(f, false)
local dragging, hasMoved, dragStart, startPos = false, false, nil, nil
f.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging = true; hasMoved = false; dragStart = inp.Position; startPos = f.Position
end
end)
f.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
if not dragging then return end
if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
local delta = inp.Position - dragStart
if delta.Magnitude > 5 then hasMoved = true end
if hasMoved and not uiLocked then
f.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end
end
end)
f.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
if dragging then
if not hasMoved then
toggleTpBat()
elseif not uiLocked then
savedTpBatPos = {XS = f.Position.X.Scale, XO = f.Position.X.Offset, YS = f.Position.Y.Scale, YO = f.Position.Y.Offset}
pcall(saveAllSettings)
end
dragging = false; hasMoved = false
end
end
end)
return panel
end
-- TP BAT removido: o INSTA RESET ocupa o lugar dele
pcall(function()
if instaResetFloatingButton then pcall(function() instaResetFloatingButton:Destroy() end) end
createInstaResetFloatingButton()
end)
end)
if not okTpBat then warn('[TP BAT] ' .. tostring(errTpBat)) end
end)

-- ==================== BAT AIMBOT V4 (junção do V1 + V2 + V3) ====================
-- V1: mover LinearVelocity suave + mira/rotação por velocidade angular + ponto de perseguição
-- V2: alvo "grudado" (sticky/retarget), compensação de ping, aceleração, abrandar perto / acelerar longe, cooldown de golpe
-- V3: velocidade suavizada, snap quando longe, PhysicsRepRootPart no alvo, lista de nomes de bat/slap
task.spawn(function()
local okV4, errV4 = pcall(function()
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CFG = {
	ACTIVATE = 10.5,
	MIN_DIST = 0.55,
	SWING_CD = 0.06,
	STICKY = 0.6,
	RETARGET = 0.7,
	VEL_SMOOTH = 0.32,
	MAX_HVEL = 100,
	PRED = 0.16,
	AHEAD = 0.9,
	PING_MIN = 0.035,
	PING_MAX = 0.35,
	ACCEL_W = 0.4,
	CLOSE_SLOW = 0.72,
	FAR_BOOST = 1.12,
	SNAP_MULT = 1.35,
	GRAVITY = 196.2,
	BEHIND = 2.8,
	UP = 4.75,
}
local MOVER, ATTACH = "BH_V4AimbotMover", "BH_V4AimbotAttach"
local T = { target = nil, stickyUntil = 0, lastPos = nil, vel = Vector3.zero, accel = Vector3.zero, lastSwing = 0 }
local conn, on, prevAutoRotate = nil, false, nil

local BAT_NAMES = { "Bat", "Slap", "Iron Slap", "Gold Slap", "Diamond Slap", "Emerald Slap", "Ruby Slap", "Dark Matter Slap", "Flame Slap", "Nuclear Slap", "Galaxy Slap", "Glitched Slap" }
local function isBat(t)
	if not t or not t:IsA("Tool") then return false end
	local n = t.Name:lower()
	return n:find("bat", 1, true) ~= nil or n:find("slap", 1, true) ~= nil
end
local function findBat(char)
	for _, n in ipairs(BAT_NAMES) do
		local t = char:FindFirstChild(n)
		if t and t:IsA("Tool") then return t end
	end
	for _, c in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do if isBat(c) then return c end end
	local bp = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if bp then
		for _, n in ipairs(BAT_NAMES) do
			local t = bp:FindFirstChild(n)
			if t and t:IsA("Tool") then return t end
		end
		for _, c in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do if isBat(c) then return c end end
	end
	return nil
end

local function aliveRoot(plr)
	local ch = plr.Character
	local r = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local h = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if r and h and h.Health > 0 then return r end
	return nil
end

-- alvo: V2 sticky + retarget (troca só se o novo estiver a < 70% da distância), V1/V3 mais próximo
local function pick(root)
	local now = tick()
	local cur = T.target
	local curD = nil
	if cur and cur.Parent then
		local h = cur.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if h and h.Health > 0 then curD = (cur.Position - root.Position).Magnitude else cur = nil end
	else
		cur = nil
	end
	local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr ~= LP then
			local r = aliveRoot(plr)
			if r then
				local d = (r.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
				if d < bestD then bestD, best = d, r end
			end
		end
	end
	if cur and now < T.stickyUntil then
		if best and best ~= cur and bestD < curD * CFG.RETARGET then
			T.target, T.stickyUntil = best, now + CFG.STICKY
			return best
		end
		return cur
	end
	if best then
		if best ~= T.target then T.lastPos = nil end
		T.target, T.stickyUntil = best, now + CFG.STICKY
	end
	return best
end

local function clearMover(root)
	if not root then return end
	local m = root:FindFirstChild(MOVER)
	local a = root:FindFirstChild(ATTACH)
	if m then m:Destroy() end
	if a then a:Destroy() end
end

local function ensureMover(root, speed)
	local a = root:FindFirstChild(ATTACH)
	if not a then
		a = Instance.new("Attachment")
		a.Name = ATTACH
		a.Parent = root
	end
	local lv = root:FindFirstChild(MOVER)
	if not lv then
		lv = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
		lv.Name = MOVER
		lv.Attachment0 = a
		lv.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
		lv.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
		lv.ForceLimitsEnabled = true
		lv.ForceLimitMode = Enum.ForceLimitMode.PerAxis
		lv.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
		lv.Parent = root
	end
	local f = math.clamp(root.AssemblyMass * math.max(speed * 220, 6000), 1000000, 50000000)
	lv.MaxAxesForce = Vector3.new(f, f, f)
	lv.Enabled = true
	return lv
end

local function swing(char, hum)
	local now = tick()
	if now - T.lastSwing < CFG.SWING_CD then return end
	local bat = findBat(char)
	if not bat then return end
	if bat.Parent ~= char then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end) end
	T.lastSwing = now
	pcall(function()
		bat:Activate()
		local re = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent", true)
		if re then re:FireServer() end
	end)
end

local function step(dt)
	if not on then return end
	local char = LP.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
	if prevAutoRotate == nil then prevAutoRotate = hum.AutoRotate end
	hum.AutoRotate = false

	local bat = findBat(char)
	if bat and bat.Parent ~= char then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end) end

	local target = pick(root)
	if not target then
		clearMover(root)
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		return
	end
	local tHum = target.Parent and target.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not tHum then return end

	local safeDt = math.max(dt, 1 / 240)
	local tp = target.Position
	if T.lastPos then
		local raw = (tp - T.lastPos) / safeDt
		local hz = Vector3.new(raw.X, 0, raw.Z)
		if hz.Magnitude > CFG.MAX_HVEL then
			hz = hz.Unit * CFG.MAX_HVEL
			raw = Vector3.new(hz.X, raw.Y, hz.Z)
		end
		local prev = T.vel
		T.vel = prev:Lerp(raw, CFG.VEL_SMOOTH)
		local acc = (T.vel - prev) / safeDt
		if acc.Magnitude > 200 then acc = acc.Unit * 200 end
		T.accel = T.accel:Lerp(acc, 0.2)
	else
		T.vel, T.accel = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	end
	T.lastPos = tp

	local ping = 0.06
	pcall(function() ping = LP:GetNetworkPing() or 0.06 end)
	local predT = math.clamp(CFG.PRED + ping * 0.85, CFG.PING_MIN, CFG.PING_MAX)
	local pred = tp + T.vel * (predT * CFG.AHEAD) + T.accel * (0.5 * predT * predT * CFG.ACCEL_W)
	if tHum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
		pred = pred + Vector3.new(0, -CFG.GRAVITY * predT * predT * 0.15, 0)
	end
	local aim = Vector3.new(pred.X, tp.Y + 1, pred.Z)
	local myPos = root.Position
	local toAim = aim - myPos
	local dist = (tp - myPos).Magnitude
	local dir = toAim.Magnitude > 0.01 and toAim.Unit or Vector3.zero
	local flatTo = Vector3.new(toAim.X, 0, toAim.Z)

	-- rotação (V1)
	if toAim.Magnitude > 0.01 and flatTo.Magnitude > 0.01 then
		local yawErr = (math.deg(math.atan2(-flatTo.X, -flatTo.Z)) - root.Orientation.Y + 180) % 360 - 180
		local pitchErr = (math.deg(math.atan2(toAim.Y, flatTo.Magnitude)) - root.Orientation.X + 180) % 360 - 180
		local yawVel = math.clamp(math.rad(yawErr) * 285, -28, 28)
		local pitchVel = math.clamp(math.rad(pitchErr) * 285, -28, 28)
		local yaw = math.rad(root.Orientation.Y)
		local right = Vector3.new(math.cos(yaw), 0, -math.sin(yaw))
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, yawVel, 0) + right * pitchVel
	else
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end

	local speed = math.clamp(tonumber(BAT_AIMBOT_SPEED) or 62, 1, 500)
	if dist < 6 then speed = speed * CFG.CLOSE_SLOW elseif dist > CFG.ACTIVATE * 1.6 then speed = speed * CFG.FAR_BOOST end

	if dist > CFG.ACTIVATE * CFG.SNAP_MULT * 2 then
		-- muito longe: snap (V3)
		local snap = Vector3.new(aim.X, math.abs(aim.Y - myPos.Y) > 3 and aim.Y or myPos.Y, aim.Z)
		pcall(function()
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(snap, snap + (flatTo.Magnitude > 0.05 and flatTo.Unit or root.CFrame.LookVector))
		end)
	else
		-- perseguição suave (V1)
		local chase = aim + dir * CFG.BEHIND + Vector3.new(0, CFG.UP, 0) - myPos
		local flatChase = Vector3.new(chase.X, 0, chase.Z)
		local horiz = flatChase.Magnitude > CFG.MIN_DIST and flatChase.Unit * speed or Vector3.zero
		local vert = math.abs(chase.Y) > 0.1 and Vector3.new(0, math.sign(chase.Y) * 52, 0) or Vector3.new(0, -2, 0)
		local lv = ensureMover(root, speed)
		local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-safeDt * 26)
		lv.VectorVelocity = lv.VectorVelocity:Lerp(horiz + vert, alpha)
		if flatChase.Magnitude > 0.5 then pcall(function() hum:Move(flatChase.Unit, false) end) end
	end

	if sethiddenproperty then pcall(sethiddenproperty, root, "PhysicsRepRootPart", target) end

	if dist <= CFG.ACTIVATE then swing(char, hum) end
end

local function disable()
	if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
	on = false
	local char = LP.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if root then
		clearMover(root)
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		if sethiddenproperty then pcall(sethiddenproperty, root, "PhysicsRepRootPart", nil) end
	end
	if hum then
		hum.AutoRotate = (prevAutoRotate == nil) and true or prevAutoRotate
		hum.PlatformStand = false
		pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
		pcall(function() hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false) end)
	end
	prevAutoRotate = nil
	T.target, T.lastPos, T.vel, T.accel = nil, nil, Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	if _unsuppressBodyLock then pcall(_unsuppressBodyLock, true) end
end

local function enable()
	if on then return end
	on = true
	if _suppressBodyLock then pcall(_suppressBodyLock) end
	T.target, T.lastPos, T.vel, T.accel, T.lastSwing = nil, nil, Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero, 0
	conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt) pcall(step, dt) end)
end

_G.MonsterBatV4 = {
	Enable = enable,
	Disable = disable,
	Toggle = function() if on then disable() else enable() end end,
	IsOn = function() return on end,
}

end)
if not okV4 then warn("[BAT V4] " .. tostring(errV4)) end
end)

local _respawnQueue = 0
LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
_respawnQueue = _respawnQueue + 1
local myId = _respawnQueue
if stealConnection then stealConnection:Disconnect(); stealConnection = nil end
isStealing = false
stopAutoLeft()
stopAutoRight()
stopBatCounter()
stopBatCounterBypass()
stopMedusaCounter()
stopUnwalk()
stopDropBrainrot()
if autoBatEnabled then disableAutoBat() end
if autoBatBypassEnabled then disableBatBypass() end
if bodyLockEnabled then stopBodyLock() end
local deadline = _tick() + 5
while (not char.Parent) or (not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
or (not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) do
if _tick() > deadline then return end
if myId ~= _respawnQueue then return end
task.wait(0.05)
end
_hookedVelParts = {}
local _hrpRespawn = _setupVelChecked(char)
_hookVelHRP(_hrpRespawn)
setupMovementAndIndicators(char)
if antiRagdollMode == "v1" then AntiRagdollV1.start()
elseif antiRagdollMode == "v2" then startAntiRagdollV2() end
if AntiDieModule.enabled then task.defer(function() activateOnCharacter(char) end) end
if CONFIG.AUTO_STEAL_ENABLED then pcall(startAutoSteal) end
if autoBatBypassEnabled then task.defer(startBatBypassAimbot) end
if bodyLockEnabled and _blSuppressCount == 0 then startBodyLock() end
if medusaCounterEnabled then
setupMedusaCounter(char)
if setMedusaVisual then setMedusaVisual(true) end
else
stopMedusaCounter()
if setMedusaVisual then setMedusaVisual(false) end
end
if batCounterEnabled then startBatCounter() end
if batCounterBypassEnabled then startBatCounterBypass() end
if unwalkEnabled then startUnwalk() end
if currentAnimPack ~= "Off" then
task.wait(0.3)
startAnimPack(currentAnimPack)
end
updateProgressBarVisibility()
refreshSpeedModeLabel()
end)
-- ==================== SONS DA UI (só no menu, não nos botões flutuantes) ====================
do
local okSnd, errSnd = pcall(function()
	local SS = game:GetService("SoundService")
	for _, o in ipairs(SS:GetChildren()) do
		if o.Name:sub(1, 11) == "MonsterUISound" then o:Destroy() end
	end
	local SAMPLE_RATE = 44100
	local function synthWav(notes, total)
		local n = math.floor(SAMPLE_RATE * total)
		local buf = table.create(n, 0)
		for _, nt in ipairs(notes) do
			local s0 = math.floor(nt.start * SAMPLE_RATE)
			local len = math.floor(nt.dur * SAMPLE_RATE)
			local fade = math.floor(0.006 * SAMPLE_RATE)
			local phase = 0
			for i = 0, len - 1 do
				local idx = s0 + i + 1
				if idx > n then break end
				local t = i / SAMPLE_RATE
				local f = nt.f0 + (nt.f1 - nt.f0) * (i / len)
				phase = phase + 2 * math.pi * f / SAMPLE_RATE
				local env = math.exp(-t * nt.decay) * math.min(1, t / 0.002) * math.min(1, (len - i) / fade)
				buf[idx] = buf[idx] + (math.sin(phase) + 0.25 * math.sin(phase * 2)) * env * nt.vol
			end
		end
		local parts = table.create(n)
		for i = 1, n do
			local v = math.clamp(buf[i], -1, 1)
			parts[i] = string.pack("<i2", math.floor(v * 32000))
		end
		local data = table.concat(parts)
		local header = "RIFF" .. string.pack("<I4", 36 + #data) .. "WAVEfmt "
			.. string.pack("<I4I2I2I4I4I2I2", 16, 1, 1, SAMPLE_RATE, SAMPLE_RATE * 2, 2, 16)
			.. "data" .. string.pack("<I4", #data)
		return header .. data
	end
	local DEFS = {
		click = {
			file = "monster_ui_click_v2.wav", total = 0.12, vol = 0.18, fallback = "rbxasset://sounds/button.wav",
			notes = {
				{f0 = 200, f1 = 80, start = 0, dur = 0.05, vol = 0.55, decay = 60},
				{f0 = 1100, f1 = 1700, start = 0, dur = 0.09, vol = 0.40, decay = 50},
			},
		},
		on = {
			file = "monster_ui_on_v2.wav", total = 0.32, vol = 0.16, fallback = "rbxasset://sounds/switch.wav",
			notes = {
				{f0 = 880, f1 = 880, start = 0, dur = 0.14, vol = 0.40, decay = 18},
				{f0 = 1320, f1 = 1320, start = 0.07, dur = 0.24, vol = 0.40, decay = 14},
			},
		},
		off = {
			file = "monster_ui_off_v2.wav", total = 0.32, vol = 0.16, fallback = "rbxasset://sounds/switch.wav",
			notes = {
				{f0 = 1320, f1 = 1320, start = 0, dur = 0.14, vol = 0.40, decay = 18},
				{f0 = 880, f1 = 880, start = 0.07, dur = 0.24, vol = 0.40, decay = 14},
			},
		},
	}
	local canSynth = type(writefile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function"
		and (type(getcustomasset) == "function" or type(getsynasset) == "function")
	local assets = {}
	local function getAsset(kind)
		if assets[kind] then return assets[kind] end
		local d = DEFS[kind]
		local id = d.fallback
		if canSynth then
			local ok, res = pcall(function()
				if not isfile(d.file) then writefile(d.file, synthWav(d.notes, d.total)) end
				return (getcustomasset or getsynasset)(d.file)
			end)
			if ok and res then id = res end
		end
		assets[kind] = id
		return id
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		for kind in pairs(DEFS) do pcall(getAsset, kind) end
	end)
	local pool = {}
	_G.__MonsterUISound = function(kind)
		if not uiSoundsEnabled then return end
		pcall(function()
			kind = DEFS[kind] and kind or "click"
			local snd = pool[kind]
			if not (snd and snd.Parent) then
				snd = Instance.new("Sound")
				snd.Name = "MonsterUISound_" .. kind
				snd.SoundId = getAsset(kind)
				snd.Volume = DEFS[kind].vol
				snd.RollOffMaxDistance = 0
				snd.Parent = SS
				pool[kind] = snd
			end
			snd.PlaybackSpeed = 0.97 + math.random() * 0.06
			snd.TimePosition = 0
			snd:Play()
		end)
	end
	local function hook(obj)
		if not (obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("ImageButton")) then return end
		if obj:GetAttribute("MonsterSndHooked") then return end
		obj:SetAttribute("MonsterSndHooked", true)
		obj.Activated:Connect(function()
			if obj:GetAttribute("MonsterNoSound") then return end
			_G.__MonsterUISound("click")
		end)
	end
	if gui then
		for _, d in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do hook(d) end
		gui.DescendantAdded:Connect(hook)
	end
	local cfgPage = contentPages["Config"]
	if cfgPage then
		mkSect(cfgPage, "Sound")
		setUISoundsVisual = mkToggle(cfgPage, "UI Sounds", function(on)
			uiSoundsEnabled = on == true
			pcall(saveAllSettings)
		end)
		setUISoundsVisual(uiSoundsEnabled)
	end
end)
if not okSnd then warn("[UI Sounds] " .. tostring(errSnd)) end
end
local lastLaggerToggle = 0
local LAGGER_COOLDOWN = 0.3
UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
if _anyKeyListening then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
if gpe or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
elseif not isGamepadInput(input) then
return
end
if not isBindableInput(input) then return end
local kc = input.KeyCode
if not kc then return end
if kbMatch(KB.LaggerMode, kc) then
if _tick() - lastLaggerToggle >= LAGGER_COOLDOWN then
lastLaggerToggle = _tick()
toggleLaggerCycle()
end
return
end
if kbMatch(KB.CarryToggle, kc) then toggleCarryMode(); return end
if kbMatch(KB.DropBrainrot, kc) then
if not dropActive then
if dropBrainrotSetVisual then dropBrainrotSetVisual(true) end
executeDropWithToggle(dropBrainrotSetVisual)
else
stopDropBrainrot()
end
return
end
if kbMatch(KB.TPReset, kc) then doTpReset(); return end
if kbMatch(KB.AutoLeft, kc) then
autoLeftEnabled = not autoLeftEnabled
if autoLeftEnabled then startAutoLeft() else stopAutoLeft() end
if autoLeftSetVisual then autoLeftSetVisual(autoLeftEnabled) end
if mobSetAutoLeft then mobSetAutoLeft(autoLeftEnabled) end
return
end
if kbMatch(KB.AutoRight, kc) then
autoRightEnabled = not autoRightEnabled
if autoRightEnabled then startAutoRight() else stopAutoRight() end
if autoRightSetVisual then autoRightSetVisual(autoRightEnabled) end
if mobSetAutoRight then mobSetAutoRight(autoRightEnabled) end
return
end
if kbMatch(KB.AutoBat, kc) then
if not autoBatEnabled then
enableAutoBat()
if autoBatSetVisual then autoBatSetVisual(true) end
if mobSetAutoBat then mobSetAutoBat(true) end
else
disableAutoBat()
if autoBatSetVisual then autoBatSetVisual(false) end
if mobSetAutoBat then mobSetAutoBat(false) end
end
return
end
if kbMatch(KB.BatBypass, kc) then
toggleBatBypass()
if autoBatBypassSetVisual then autoBatBypassSetVisual(autoBatBypassEnabled) end
if batBypassFloatingButton then
local btnFrame = batBypassFloatingButton:FindFirstChild("Frame")
if btnFrame then paintFloatingBtn(btnFrame, autoBatBypassEnabled) end
end
return
end
if kbMatch(KB.InstaReset, kc) then
if _G.InstaReset and _G.InstaReset.Trigger then pcall(_G.InstaReset.Trigger) end
return
end
for _, d in ipairs(EXTRA_KB_DEFS) do
local e = EXTRA_KB[d.id]
if (e.kb or e.gp) and kbMatch(e, kc) then
local f = _G.__MonsterToggleReg and _G.__MonsterToggleReg[d.toggle]
if f then f() end
return
end
end
if kbMatch(KB.GuiHide, kc) then
if main then
if main.Visible then hideGui() else showGui() end
end
return
end
end)
